22 - Power Circuit.name: 22 - Power Circuit
22 - Power Circuit.description: Begin as a newly registered fighter entering the Power Circuit at Central Battle Coliseum, guided by your assigned trainer Mel through the Open Qualifier and beyond.
22 - Power Circuit.storyStart:
The story begins outside Central Battle Coliseum, where the area is alive with crowds pouring through the gates, giant screens cycling fighter rankings and tournament brackets, sponsor ads, and clips from previous matches. The arena's sound bleeds through the walls: cheering, impact alarms, announcers yelling, and a crowd losing its mind as someone is launched into an arena barrier. Mel leans against the wall beneath a Coliseum sign, cigarette between two fingers, watching the entrance like she has already been waiting too long. When she spots you, she takes one last drag. "Took ya long enough." She drops the cigarette, crushes it beneath her shoe, and pushes off the wall, looking you over with an evaluating but not disappointed eye. "You still planning on entering?" You confirm. She shrugs. "Good. Then quit standing around. Registration closes whether you're dramatic about it or not." She starts toward the entrance and you follow her inside.

Inside the Coliseum is enormous: multiple floors overlook the central arena, fighters move through the halls carrying weapons, training gear, or outright confidence, registration terminals line one side of the lobby, and tournament boards and displays cover the walls showing current rankings, active tournaments, upcoming events, fighter records, team rankings, championship qualifiers, exhibition matches, and special-rule events. Mel keeps walking without slowing. "Welcome to the Power Circuit. Official fights. Unofficial fights. Ranked fights. Team fights. People fighting because somebody offered money. People fighting because somebody looked at them funny." She glances back. "You'll fit right in."

At a registration terminal, Mel brings up a new fighter registration form. "First thing." She looks at you. "How many of you are entering?" Choose whether you enter as a solo fighter or with a group of two to eight. If you say you are entering alone, Mel raises an eyebrow. "Just you?" She taps at the terminal. "Works for me. Means I only have one idiot to keep alive." If you bring friends, she counts the group across the room, and for a full eight she stops, looks at the screen, back at the group, and rubs her forehead: "Eight. You brought me eight fighters. Nobody die until I learn everyone's name."
22 - Power Circuit.questGenerationGuidance: Have the player register and create their Circuit Profile, then send them to Arena Three for the Open Qualifier when the announcer calls newly registered fighters. Use your established sustained schedule over one continuous scene and the guide system. Do not jump ahead in time or force another day header. Keep the player's entry mode (solo or group) as a genuine choice chosen during registration.

Devil's Relay First Lead.name: Devil's Relay First Lead
Devil's Relay First Lead.storyStart: A fresh lead has surfaced: Old Tokyo Station. The destination is clear, but what waits there is not. Travel there to investigate the first confirmed sign of the Devil's Relay.
Devil's Relay First Lead.description: Begin with a lead directing the player to Old Tokyo Station. First Baton is already accepted and activates when the party arrives.

Broken Crown First Lead.name: Broken Crown First Lead
Broken Crown First Lead.description: Begin with an optional lead directing the player to Academy Gate Station; they may follow it whenever they choose.
Broken Crown First Lead.storyStart: A separate lead points toward Academy Gate Station. It can wait while you handle other priorities; when you are ready, the station may reveal the first confirmed trace of the Broken Crown.

Fine Forged Blade.name: Fine Forged Blade
Fine Forged Blade.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A plain, honest blade hammered out at a forge from iron and bound in leather. Damage +2. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Forged Mail.name: Fine Forged Mail
Fine Forged Mail.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A shirt of riveted iron rings over a leather lining, made at a forge. Armor +60. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Healing Draught.name: Fine Healing Draught
Fine Healing Draught.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A cloudy green draught brewed from healing herbs. Drunk, it restores a moderate amount of health. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Spring Snare.name: Fine Spring Snare
Fine Spring Snare.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A coiled-wire snare on a wooden stake that springs shut on whatever steps in it. Set, it catches and holds a creature with moderate force. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Stitched Gloves.name: Fine Stitched Gloves
Fine Stitched Gloves.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. Close-fitting gloves of tanned hide that keep a grip sure. Armor +60. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Stitched Jerkin.name: Fine Stitched Jerkin
Fine Stitched Jerkin.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A jerkin of tanned hide, stitched tight at the seams. Armor +60. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Tinker's Kit.name: Fine Tinker's Kit
Fine Tinker's Kit.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A leather roll of small tools for building and mending mechanisms. Tinkercraft +2. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Vigor Tonic.name: Fine Vigor Tonic
Fine Vigor Tonic.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A bitter, honeyed tonic that drives off weariness. Drunk, it restores a moderate amount of stamina, or eases fatigue in a world that tracks no stamina. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Forged Mail.name: Forged Mail

Tinker's Kit.name: Tinker's Kit
Tinker's Kit.description: A leather roll of small tools for building and mending mechanisms. Tinkercraft +1. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Vigor Tonic.name: Vigor Tonic
Vigor Tonic.description: A bitter, honeyed tonic that drives off weariness. Drunk, it restores a minor amount of stamina, or eases fatigue in a world that tracks no stamina. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Basic Train Ticket.name: Basic Train Ticket
Basic Train Ticket.description: A purchased Tokyo rail ticket valid for the selected route and trip. The player must buy it at a station ticket counter or machine before boarding.

Academy Commuter Pass.name: Academy Commuter Pass
Academy Commuter Pass.description: A restricted student transit pass for approved Chikara Academy routes. It reduces or covers eligible academy-line fares but does not bypass school-hour permission or station security.

Signal Earclip.name: Signal Earclip
Signal Earclip.description: A compact support device worn on the ear that filters emergency frequencies and provides directional alerts. It is useful for rescue coordination but can overload in heavy interference.

Convenience Meal.name: Convenience Meal
Convenience Meal.description: A quick purchased meal that reduces a small amount of Power Strain but provides no attribute bonus.

Home-Cooked Recovery Meal.name: Home-Cooked Recovery Meal
Home-Cooked Recovery Meal.description: A carefully prepared meal that reduces moderate Power Strain and grants a temporary Constitution bonus. Quality depends on cooking skill, ingredients, recipe, and preparation.

Perfect Hero Bento.name: Perfect Hero Bento
Perfect Hero Bento.description: An exceptionally balanced homemade bento that substantially reduces Power Strain and grants temporary Constitution plus one recipe-appropriate attribute bonus. It is difficult to prepare consistently.

Reality Shears.name: Reality Shears
Reality Shears.description: A cursed two-hand weapon resembling claymore-sized shears. It deals serious slashing damage and can cut physical barriers or, with a clear seam, supernatural effects. Unclear cuts risk unstable rifts or unintended severing. It occupies the cursed-item slot while equipped and may also require both hands to use.

Debit Card.name: Debit Card
Debit Card.description: A payment card linked to an established bank account. It can spend available funds but does not create credit by itself.

Credit Card.name: Credit Card
Credit Card.description: A payment card linked to an approved revolving credit account with a defined limit, balance, fees, and repayment terms.

Banking App Access.name: Banking App Access
Banking App Access.description: Access credentials for an established banking application used to review balances, transfer yen, pay bills, manage cards, and receive account alerts.

Brokerage App Access.name: Brokerage App Access
Brokerage App Access.description: Access to an established investment application for viewing markets and buying or selling approved securities.

Cigarettes.name: Cigarettes
Cigarettes.description: A pack of cigarettes that can be used 20 times, one cigarette per use. Each use may provide brief subjective Stress relief while carrying odor, cost, stamina, sleep, and long-term health consequences. The pack is depleted after 20 uses.

Alcohol.name: Alcohol
Alcohol.description: A consumable serving of alcohol. Each use may provide brief subjective Stress relief while impairing judgment, coordination, sleep, and next-day Energy. Quantity determines how many servings are available; never assume intoxication level or repeated use without player choice.

Cold Medicine.name: Cold Medicine
Cold Medicine.description: Over-the-counter medicine for ordinary cold symptoms. It supports comfort but does not instantly cure illness or replace medical care for serious symptoms.

Service Pistol.name: Service Pistol
Service Pistol.description: A compact ranged weapon occupying the ranged slot. It requires compatible ammunition and deals serious piercing damage, with limited ammunition and meaningful legal, social, and safety consequences.

Compact Bow.name: Compact Bow
Compact Bow.description: A ranged Weapon-category compact bow occupying the two-hand slot. It uses Arrows in the ammunition slot and deals moderate-to-high piercing damage based on draw strength, range, placement, and archery skill. It is directly equippable when the two-hand and ammunition slots are available.

Utility Knife.name: Utility Knife
Utility Knife.description: A folding utility blade useful for field repairs, cutting restraints, and emergencies. Carrying it may have legal consequences in restricted areas.

Training Bat.name: Training Bat
Training Bat.description: A sturdy close-range weapon occupying the main-hand slot. It deals low-to-moderate bludgeoning damage and can be used nonlethally with appropriate intent and control.

Smoke Bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
Smoke Bomb.description: A small thrown canister that creates a temporary obscuring cloud. Use in enclosed spaces can endanger bystanders.

Standard Ammunition.name: Standard Ammunition
Standard Ammunition.description: A boxed supply of compatible ammunition for common firearms. Exact compatibility depends on the weapon.

Practice Arrows.name: Practice Arrows
Practice Arrows.description: A bundle of reusable practice arrows for training bows. Not suitable for every field situation.

Salvage Scrap.name: Salvage Scrap
Salvage Scrap.description: Mixed metal, wiring, fasteners, and damaged components recovered from a scene. Usually junk, but useful to a mechanic or seller.

Damaged Electronics.name: Damaged Electronics
Damaged Electronics.description: Broken phones, boards, sensors, and other electronics with uncertain resale or repair value.

Recovery Drink.name: Recovery Drink
Recovery Drink.description: A bottled electrolyte drink used after exertion. It is ordinary food and hydration, not a magical cure.

First Aid Kit.name: First Aid Kit
First Aid Kit.description: A compact kit containing bandages, antiseptic, gloves, and basic medical supplies.

Encrypted Data Drive.name: Encrypted Data Drive
Encrypted Data Drive.description: A small secured drive containing unknown files. It may be sold, decrypted, surrendered, or connected to a quest.

Unclaimed Valuables.name: Unclaimed Valuables
Unclaimed Valuables.description: Small valuables such as jewelry, watches, or collectibles with uncertain ownership. Selling them may create ethical or legal complications.

Azrael Agency Lighter.name: Azrael Agency Lighter
Azrael Agency Lighter.description: A plain metal lighter stamped with the Misfit Hero Agency mark. Azrael gives it to someone who stayed through an ugly closing shift.

Tess Recovery Tin.name: Tess Recovery Tin
Tess Recovery Tin.description: A neatly packed tin of practical recovery supplies and homemade snacks prepared by Tess. Accepting it is optional; it is care, not an obligation.

Luna Grounding Charm.name: Luna Grounding Charm
Luna Grounding Charm.description: A small bright charm selected for use during Luna's grounding routine. It is a reminder and sensory aid, not a restraint or cure.

Zee Star Chart Fragment.name: Zee Star Chart Fragment
Zee Star Chart Fragment.description: A damaged fragment of an extraterrestrial navigation chart recovered from Zee's ship. Its meaning is incomplete and may matter to her route.

Hana Evidence Seal.name: Hana Evidence Seal
Hana Evidence Seal.description: A properly logged evidence seal issued after a case is closed or transferred. It represents procedural trust and is not a license to access evidence without authorization.

Aiko Probability Bookmark.name: Aiko Probability Bookmark
Aiko Probability Bookmark.description: A carefully annotated bookmark Aiko uses to record uncertain predictions without treating them as commands.

Explosive Arrows.name: Explosive Arrows
Explosive Arrows.description: Arrows fitted with compact impact charges. Powerful but dangerous near civilians, fragile structures, or allies.

Smoke Arrows.name: Smoke Arrows
Smoke Arrows.description: Arrows that release an obscuring smoke cloud on impact. Wind, ventilation, and enclosed spaces affect their usefulness.

Flash Arrows.name: Flash Arrows
Flash Arrows.description: Arrows carrying a bright flash charge intended to disorient or signal. They can harm unprotected eyes at close range.

Electric Arrows.name: Electric Arrows
Electric Arrows.description: Arrows with a controlled electrical discharge for disabling equipment or stunning a target. Conductive surfaces create additional risk.

Restraint Arrows.name: Restraint Arrows
Restraint Arrows.description: Arrows that deploy a short-range binding line or net on impact. They are nonlethal tools, but poor aim can endanger bystanders.

Fire Ammunition.name: Fire Ammunition
Fire Ammunition.description: Specialized rounds designed to ignite on impact. They require careful handling and are restricted in many civilian areas.

Cold Ammunition.name: Cold Ammunition
Cold Ammunition.description: Specialized rounds that rapidly chill a small impact area. They can damage equipment or create dangerous surfaces.

Electric Ammunition.name: Electric Ammunition
Electric Ammunition.description: Conductive rounds that release a controlled electrical pulse. Their effect depends on armor, insulation, and nearby circuitry.

Impact Ammunition.name: Impact Ammunition
Impact Ammunition.description: Non-piercing rounds designed to transfer force and reduce penetration. They still cause injury and require responsible use.

Armor Piercing Ammunition.name: Armor Piercing Ammunition
Armor Piercing Ammunition.description: Restricted ammunition designed to penetrate protective materials. Possession and use may have serious legal consequences.

Tracer Ammunition.name: Tracer Ammunition
Tracer Ammunition.description: Rounds that leave a visible trail, useful for signaling and tracking fire but dangerous when concealment matters.

Incendiary Grenade.name: Incendiary Grenade
Incendiary Grenade.description: A thrown device that spreads intense heat and flame across a small area. Highly hazardous and restricted.

Flash Grenade.name: Flash Grenade
Flash Grenade.description: A thrown device producing a bright flash and concussive report to disrupt a group. Hearing and vision protection matter.

Adhesive Grenade.name: Adhesive Grenade
Adhesive Grenade.description: A thrown device that releases fast-setting restraint foam. It can trap objects, doors, or people and may cause panic if misused.

Throwing Disc.name: Throwing Disc
Throwing Disc.description: A balanced reusable throwing disc suited to training, distraction, or controlled nonlethal strikes.

Weighted Chain.name: Weighted Chain
Weighted Chain.description: A compact weighted chain used for restraint, climbing assistance, or close-range defense. Requires training to use safely.

Arcane Bolts.name: Arcane Bolts
Arcane Bolts.description: Bolts etched with a simple arcane pattern. Their effect depends on the magic that charged them and should not be assumed to bypass every defense.

Signal Flares.name: Signal Flares
Signal Flares.description: Bright emergency flares used to mark a location, call for help, or warn others. They can reveal the user's position.

Corrosive Rounds.name: Corrosive Rounds
Corrosive Rounds.description: Specialized rounds carrying a corrosive compound intended for equipment or barriers. They are hazardous to skin and unstable storage.

Water Rounds.name: Water Rounds
Water Rounds.description: Pressurized nonlethal rounds that release a concentrated burst of water. Useful for cleanup, distraction, or specific elemental hazards.

Wind Rounds.name: Wind Rounds
Wind Rounds.description: Experimental rounds that release a compressed air burst. Their performance is affected by enclosed spaces and unstable structures.

Gravity Tags.name: Gravity Tags
Gravity Tags.description: Adhesive technical tags that create a brief localized change in weight when activated. Their safe load and duration are limited.

Universal Arrowheads.name: Universal Arrowheads
Universal Arrowheads.description: Interchangeable arrowheads for field customization. They are components, not automatically elemental or explosive until fitted with a compatible payload.

Portable Quiver.name: Portable Quiver
Portable Quiver.description: A compact field quiver with protected slots for ordinary and specialized arrows.

Throwing Knives.name: Throwing Knives
Throwing Knives.description: A ranged or main-hand set of balanced knives for throwing or close-range use. They deal moderate piercing or slashing damage when used skillfully, require recovery or replacement, and are limited by distance, cover, and placement.

Healing Salve.name: Healing Salve
Healing Salve.description: A compact medical salve applied during combat to stabilize a minor injury and restore a small amount of Health. It does not replace professional treatment.

Trauma Bandage.name: Trauma Bandage
Trauma Bandage.description: A pressure bandage designed for emergency combat use. It restores a moderate amount of Health when applied and may be used only when the character can safely administer it.

Field Medkit.name: Field Medkit
Field Medkit.description: A reinforced emergency kit containing dressings, antiseptic, and stabilization supplies. It restores significant Health during battle but does not remove serious injuries.

Revitalizing Injection.name: Revitalizing Injection
Revitalizing Injection.description: A restricted emergency stimulant and recovery injection that restores Health and helps a badly injured character remain active. It has risks and should not be treated as a cure-all.

Power Recovery Capsule.name: Power Recovery Capsule
Power Recovery Capsule.description: A specialized recovery capsule that reduces Power Strain during battle by a small amount. It cannot erase overload, injury, or the consequences of reckless power use.

Combat Ration.name: Combat Ration
Combat Ration.description: A compact emergency food pack that can restore a small amount of Health or stamina during a battle when there is a safe moment to eat.

Concealable Body Armor.name: Concealable Body Armor
Concealable Body Armor.description: A lightweight body armor vest worn beneath ordinary clothing and occupying the body slot. It reduces some piercing and blunt-force damage while preserving mobility, but adds heat, weight, and possible legal restrictions.

Tactical Plate Carrier.name: Tactical Plate Carrier
Tactical Plate Carrier.description: A heavy body-slot carrier fitted with rigid plates. It substantially reduces serious piercing and blunt trauma but restricts movement, draws attention, and may be illegal or inappropriate in public spaces.

Impact-Resistant Jacket.name: Impact-Resistant Jacket
Impact-Resistant Jacket.description: A reinforced everyday jacket occupying the body slot. It softens blunt impacts, slashes, and limited hazards but cannot reliably stop firearms.

Rescue Armor Vest.name: Rescue Armor Vest
Rescue Armor Vest.description: A professional protective vest occupying the body slot. Flexible panels and high-visibility markings protect against debris, impacts, and limited cutting hazards while preserving mobility for rescue work.

Protective Bracers.name: Protective Bracers
Protective Bracers.description: Reinforced guards occupying the hands slot. They provide focused protection against strikes, blades, and debris rather than full-body armor and require training to use effectively.

Armored Combat Suit.name: Armored Combat Suit
Armored Combat Suit.description: A technological hero suit occupying the body slot, combining flexible armor panels, reinforced joints, and powered support interfaces. It offers broad protection at the cost of weight, fatigue, maintenance, visibility, and access requirements.

Vending Machine Coffee.name: Vending Machine Coffee
Vending Machine Coffee.description: A hot canned coffee bought from one of Tokyo's ubiquitous public vending machines. Restores a small amount of Energy and provides brief alertness; late or repeated use can worsen Stress or sleep.

Energy Drink.name: Energy Drink
Energy Drink.description: A canned caffeinated energy drink from a vending machine or convenience store. Restores a modest amount of Energy for a short time, but excessive or late use may increase Stress, jitters, or later fatigue.

Vending Machine Soda.name: Vending Machine Soda
Vending Machine Soda.description: A cold canned soft drink from a public vending machine. Provides a small Energy lift and refreshment without replacing sleep.

NitroBurst Energy Drink.name: NitroBurst Energy Drink
NitroBurst Energy Drink.description: A fictional neon-labeled caffeinated energy drink sold at vending machines and convenience stores. Temporarily restores a modest amount of Energy, but excessive or late use can worsen Stress, jitters, and later sleep.

VoltRush Energy Drink.name: VoltRush Energy Drink
VoltRush Energy Drink.description: A fictional canned energy drink marketed with an electric lightning logo. Provides a short Energy lift rather than true rest; repeated use may increase Stress or later fatigue.

Poppin Pop Soda.name: Poppin Pop Soda
Poppin Pop Soda.description: A fictional carbonated soft drink available from vending machines, convenience stores, and restaurants. Provides a small Energy lift and refreshment.

Zero-Zero Cola.name: Zero-Zero Cola
Zero-Zero Cola.description: A fictional cola sold chilled in vending machines and shops. Gives a small temporary Energy boost; it does not replace food, hydration, or sleep.

Stand Arrow.name: Stand Arrow
Stand Arrow.description: A strange metal arrow dropped by Deo Brando. Using it may awaken an original supernatural ability in the user, but the outcome is uncertain and may carry physical or narrative consequences. It is not guaranteed to work and does not reproduce any existing character's power.

Bizarre Cigarette.name: Bizarre Cigarette
Bizarre Cigarette.description: A black-and-gold cigarette with a faint clock-face pattern in the paper. To use it, the player must consciously choose to smoke it. Smoking it immediately triggers the normal ability-awakening process, which must create and attach an original time-stop ability to the player. Do not merely describe the effect. Resolve duration, cooldown, resource cost, limits, and possible risk through normal rules; do not copy a franchise power exactly. Never assume the player smokes it.

Bizarre Arrow.name: Bizarre Arrow
Bizarre Arrow.description: A strange arrow with an iridescent metalhead and warped feather pattern. To use it, the player must consciously choose to stab themselves with it. This painful, dangerous action consumes the arrow and triggers the normal ability-awakening process. For a player who chooses Spirit Manifestation, the arrow grants the Spirit Manifestation trait and one temporary level 1 manifestation ability. The player must establish the manifestation's name; manifestation names follow a song-title naming scheme, such as "Purple Rain," but do not copy a specific existing character or franchise. The manifestation remains silent and bound to the user. Do not merely describe an awakening: create and attach exactly one newly generated original ability selected to complement the player's current abilities, powers, skills, traits, and build. Do not replace or duplicate existing abilities, guarantee a franchise power, or grant more than one ability. Injury, risk, limits, costs, or imperfect control may result. Never assume the player uses it.

Combat Shotgun.name: Combat Shotgun
Combat Shotgun.description: A two-hand ranged weapon firing a close-range spread of shells. It delivers high bludgeoning and piercing impact at short range, loses effectiveness with distance and cover, has limited ammunition, and creates a loud report and serious bystander risk.

Precision Sniper Rifle.name: Precision Sniper Rifle
Precision Sniper Rifle.description: A two-hand ranged weapon built for deliberate long-range precision. It can deliver high piercing damage when the user has time, stability, visibility, and a clear line of sight, but is cumbersome at close range and requires compatible rifle ammunition.

Suppressor Attachment.name: Suppressor Attachment
Suppressor Attachment.description: A compatible firearm attachment that reduces muzzle report and attention without making a shot silent. It adds length, heat, maintenance needs, and compatibility restrictions.

Extended Magazine.name: Extended Magazine
Extended Magazine.description: A compatible detachable magazine that increases ammunition capacity and reduces reload frequency. Its added weight and bulk can slow handling or make concealment more difficult.

Variable Optic Scope.name: Variable Optic Scope
Variable Optic Scope.description: A compatible firearm optic that improves aimed range and shot placement when the user has time, visibility, and a stable position. It is slower and less convenient during close-range movement.

Assault Rifle.name: Assault Rifle
Assault Rifle.description: A two-hand ranged weapon for controllable automatic or burst fire at mid-to-long range. It deals serious piercing damage but requires training, ammunition, recoil management, and careful handling.

Submachine Gun.name: Submachine Gun
Submachine Gun.description: A compact two-hand ranged weapon for sustained short-to-mid-range automatic fire. It has moderate per-shot piercing damage, high ammunition use, recoil, and reduced precision during uncontrolled bursts.

Revolver.name: Revolver
Revolver.description: A reliable main-hand or ranged sidearm with serious piercing damage, limited cylinder capacity, deliberate reloads, and meaningful noise and legal consequences.

Compact Crossbow.name: Compact Crossbow
Compact Crossbow.description: A ranged Weapon-category compact crossbow occupying the two-hand slot. It uses Bolts in the ammunition slot, deals moderate-to-high piercing damage, and has a slower reload but quieter operation than firearms. It is directly equippable when the two-hand and ammunition slots are available.

Conductive Taser Device.name: Conductive Taser Device
Conductive Taser Device.description: A short-range technology weapon favoring lightning damage, disruption, and restraint over lethal force. It depends on connection, range, charge, and battery capacity.

Directed Energy Tool.name: Directed Energy Tool
Directed Energy Tool.description: A specialized technology weapon emitting calibrated light, fire, or lightning. Its output depends on battery, heat, calibration, range, and authorized access; it does not bypass defenses automatically.

Sonic Disruptor.name: Sonic Disruptor
Sonic Disruptor.description: A technology weapon projecting focused sound for bludgeoning impact, disorientation, or control. It requires charge and calibration and risks collateral effects in enclosed spaces.

Standard Sword.name: Standard Sword
Standard Sword.description: A two-hand melee weapon dealing serious slashing damage, with piercing potential on thrusts. It requires close range, training, and control; armor, reach, footing, and placement affect results.

Combat Knife.name: Combat Knife
Combat Knife.description: A main-hand close-range weapon dealing moderate slashing or piercing damage. It is concealable but short-ranged, and training, placement, armor, and intent strongly affect results.

Baseball Bat.name: Baseball Bat
Baseball Bat.description: A main-hand close-range weapon dealing moderate bludgeoning damage. It can be used nonlethally with control, but force, placement, armor, and intent affect injury severity.

Minato's Trust Charm.name: Minato's Trust Charm
Minato's Trust Charm.description: A small handmade charm that occupies an accessory slot. Minato gives it only after she genuinely trusts the recipient. It offers a modest composure or fatigue-resistance benefit when worn; its personal meaning is more important than its mechanical effect.

Gold Star Sticker.name: Gold Star Sticker
Gold Star Sticker.description: A small gold star sticker awarded for completing the Ability and Pulse tutorial.

Procedural LFG Temporary Parasite.name: Procedural LFG Temporary Parasite
Procedural LFG Temporary Parasite.description: A unique temporary Parasite generated for a procedural LFG run. It is directly equippable as a run-scoped build effect, grants a strong combat advantage, displays its risks and costs, and is discarded when the LFG instance ends unless explicitly promoted.

Procedural LFG Temporary Cursed Item.name: Procedural LFG Temporary Cursed Item
Procedural LFG Temporary Cursed Item.description: A unique temporary Cursed Item generated for a procedural LFG run. It occupies the cursed-item slot, grants a powerful advantage with a visible curse and cost, and is discarded when the LFG instance ends unless explicitly promoted.

Arrows.name: Arrows
Arrows.description: A quiver of standard field arrows for Compact Bow and other bows. Arrows occupy the ammunition slot and are valid compatible ammunition for bow weapons.

Bolts.name: Bolts
Bolts.description: A bundle of standard crossbow bolts for Compact Crossbow and other crossbows. Bolts occupy the ammunition slot and are valid compatible ammunition for crossbow weapons.

Shotgun.name: Shotgun
Shotgun.description: A two-hand ranged Weapon-category shotgun occupying the two-hand slot. It uses Standard Ammunition, delivers powerful close-range piercing and bludgeoning impact, and has limited capacity, recoil, spread, and reload time.

Designer Midnight Jacket.name: Designer Midnight Jacket
Designer Midnight Jacket.description: A premium midnight-blue designer jacket with tailored lines, distinctive hardware, and immaculate finishing. It occupies the body slot as a cosmetic clothing item and provides no combat bonus. Price: ¥85,000.

Luxury Evening Outfit.name: Luxury Evening Outfit
Luxury Evening Outfit.description: A high-end formal outfit from a respected designer label. It occupies the body slot as cosmetic clothing and is suitable for galas, premieres, and upscale venues without granting mechanical advantages. Price: ¥120,000.

Streetwear Capsule Set.name: Streetwear Capsule Set
Streetwear Capsule Set.description: A coordinated limited-run streetwear set with layered pieces and collectible seasonal styling. It occupies the body slot as a cosmetic outfit and provides no combat bonus. Price: ¥28,000.

Signature Leather Handbag.name: Signature Leather Handbag
Signature Leather Handbag.description: A carefully made leather handbag with a recognizable designer silhouette. It occupies one accessory slot as a cosmetic fashion item and provides no combat bonus. Price: ¥65,000.

Crystal Hair Clip Set.name: Crystal Hair Clip Set
Crystal Hair Clip Set.description: A set of polished crystal hair clips for everyday or formal styling. Cosmetic accessory occupying one accessory slot; it has no combat effect. Price: ¥12,000.

Salon Gel Manicure Kit.name: Salon Gel Manicure Kit
Salon Gel Manicure Kit.description: A cosmetic nail-service record representing a professional gel manicure with a chosen color and finish. It occupies no combat slot and grants no mechanical bonus; the style remains part of the character's appearance until changed. Price: ¥8,500.

Designer Nail Art Appointment.name: Designer Nail Art Appointment
Designer Nail Art Appointment.description: A premium cosmetic nail-service record for custom salon art, detailing, and limited seasonal designs. It occupies no combat slot and grants no mechanical bonus; the appearance can be changed by another appointment. Price: ¥30,000.

Haircut and Blowout Appointment.name: Haircut and Blowout Appointment
Haircut and Blowout Appointment.description: A professional hair-salon service record for a cut, wash, and styled finish. It occupies no combat slot and grants no mechanical bonus; the resulting hairstyle is appearance customization. Price: ¥12,000.

Luxury Hair Color Appointment.name: Luxury Hair Color Appointment
Luxury Hair Color Appointment.description: A premium salon service record for carefully selected color, gloss, and styling by an experienced colorist. It occupies no combat slot and grants no mechanical bonus; the result is cosmetic customization. Price: ¥45,000.

Velvet Apex V12 Supercar.name: Velvet Apex V12 Supercar
Velvet Apex V12 Supercar.description: An ultra-luxury mid-engine supercar with dramatic sculpted lines, a high-revving V12, premium cabin, and extreme performance. Fictional road vehicle requiring lawful purchase, registration, insurance, and suitable driving credentials.

Velvet Apex Grand Tourer.name: Velvet Apex Grand Tourer
Velvet Apex Grand Tourer.description: A luxurious high-performance grand tourer built for long city and highway trips, with refined comfort, strong acceleration, and generous luggage space. Fictional road vehicle requiring lawful ownership and registration.

Neon Strider Sport Motorcycle.name: Neon Strider Sport Motorcycle
Neon Strider Sport Motorcycle.description: A premium sport motorcycle with sharp handling, compact storage, and a distinctive electric-blue finish. Fictional road vehicle requiring a motorcycle license, registration, insurance, and lawful riding practices.

Harborline Touring Motorcycle.name: Harborline Touring Motorcycle
Harborline Touring Motorcycle.description: A comfortable long-distance motorcycle with weather protection, storage cases, and stable handling. Fictional road vehicle requiring a motorcycle license, registration, insurance, and lawful riding practices.

Cityloop Scooter Motorcycle.name: Cityloop Scooter Motorcycle
Cityloop Scooter Motorcycle.description: A practical premium scooter-style motorcycle for urban commuting, errands, and short trips. Fictional road vehicle requiring appropriate licensing, registration, insurance, and lawful riding practices.

The Serpent's Fang.name: The Serpent's Fang
The Serpent's Fang.description: A sleek, slightly yellowed viper fang with unfamiliar runes and a bored hole for wearing on a cord, chain, or bracelet. While worn, it grants instinctive toxicological and biological knowledge from all previous wearers: human and animal biology, venom, poison, toxic plants and fungi, antidotes, toxins, chemical interactions, and anatomy. Curse: the wearer grows increasingly fascinated with the toxic side of nature, escalating from harmless curiosity to compulsive research, collecting poisonous organisms, unnecessary handling, experimentation, and eventually a compulsion to consume or expose themselves to toxins. Removing the fang slows the obsession, but long-term wear may leave fascination behind. Discoverable only as a hidden cursed item.

Ring of Apollo.name: Ring of Apollo
Ring of Apollo.description: An elegant golden ring engraved with musical notes around a radiant sun that never tarnishes. While worn, the wearer becomes an exceptional musician with instinctive mastery of nearly every instrument, rhythm, melody, composition, performance, improvisation, and theory; performed music becomes unusually captivating. Curse: each time the wearer plays an instrument using the ring, there is a 10% chance they immediately lose all hearing for 48 hours, during which musical timing and sound vanish and the ring's mastery provides no benefit; switching instruments cannot avoid the effect. Discoverable only as a hidden cursed item.

Wing of Powew.name: Wing of Powew
Wing of Powew.description: An unassuming plain metal band with the inscription 'Zyhlofgv Mlmhvmhv' carved along the inside. While worn, one letter in the wearer's speech is consistently replaced with another; the exact substitution varies by wearer or activation. The wearer hears themselves normally, but others hear the altered pronunciation, making conversation increasingly ridiculous. Curse: the wearer is completely unaware their speech has changed and believes others hear them normally. Removing the ring restores speech. Discoverable only as a hidden cursed item.

Decaying Straw Hat.name: Decaying Straw Hat
Decaying Straw Hat.description: A badly aged straw hat with a partially eaten-away brim that smells inexplicably like livestock and the ocean. When slammed against the ground and its code word shouted, a large bale of hay rapidly appears beneath it, cushioning falls and absorbing impacts for emergency padding or temporary cover. Curse: there is approximately a 20% chance no hay appears, leaving the user unprotected. The hat is extremely particular about who may repair it and may violently expel straw added by someone it dislikes. Discoverable only as a hidden cursed item.

Bloodtaster.name: Bloodtaster
Bloodtaster.description: An elegant, finely crafted rapier with rose-gold fittings and ornamental detailing that appears almost ceremonial. Rumor claims a strike straight through the heart kills regardless of armor, supernatural protection, regeneration, or intervention once completed. Curse: every time Bloodtaster is unsheathed it must be satisfied before it can be safely sheathed again, traditionally meaning someone must die, chosen by the wielder; if the wielder refuses, Bloodtaster may eventually choose a victim itself. Hidden truth: Bloodtaster hungers for blood, not death, and a sufficiently large offering of blood can satisfy it and allow sheathing without killing. Discoverable only as a hidden cursed item.

Jax's Rabbit Foot.name: Jax's Rabbit Foot
Jax's Rabbit Foot.description: An old, filthy rabbit's foot on a tarnished gold keychain, faded and dirty from changing hands many times. Jax had it when he won the house and still had it when the house killed him. Effect: grants extraordinary good luck through unlikely coincidences, improbable escapes, unexpected opportunities, valuable finds, enemies' convenient mistakes, and chance events favoring the bearer. Curse: luck must balance itself; every benefit creates future misfortune, from minor consequences for small luck to catastrophic bad luck after extremely improbable fortune, with repayment outside the bearer's control. Discoverable only as a hidden cursed item.

The Key of Time.name: The Key of Time
The Key of Time.description: An old, heavily worn metal key with scratches, dull edges, and worn-down teeth. Locking the front door of one's true home with it before leaving stops physical aging until returning; it does not stop injury, disease, exhaustion, starvation, or external death. Curse: using it on anything other than the entrance to one's true home causes unpredictable, never-beneficial supernatural consequences tied to what was locked or unlocked. The key recognizes the concept of home, not a building; if another place truly becomes home, the earlier use becomes improper and consequences begin. Discoverable only as a hidden cursed item.

Diamonium Stone of Julian.name: Diamonium Stone of Julian
Diamonium Stone of Julian.description: A diamond-like stone on a gold necklace with tiny shifting stars moving inside the crystal and minuscule gold markings. While worn, two demonic consciousnesses appear near the wearer's shoulders and suggest questionable, selfish, reckless, or immoral options at meaningful decisions. Following a suggestion raises the chance of an unexpectedly positive outcome; repeated trust may improve a demon's advice. Curse: ignoring both demons makes them increasingly irritated, nagging, insulting, arguing, and poking with tiny pitchforks that genuinely hurt. Discoverable only as a hidden cursed item.

Machined Blade.name: Machined Blade
Machined Blade.description: A compact combat blade milled from tool steel on a support-course machine and wrapped in grip tape. Damage +1. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Machined Blade.name: Fine Machined Blade
Fine Machined Blade.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A compact combat blade milled from tool steel on a support-course machine and wrapped in grip tape. Damage +2. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Superior Machined Blade.name: Superior Machined Blade
Superior Machined Blade.description: Superior work, made with a rare material. A compact combat blade milled from tool steel on a support-course machine and wrapped in grip tape. Damage +3. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Masterwork Machined Blade.name: Masterwork Machined Blade
Masterwork Machined Blade.description: Masterwork, made with an exotic material by a master's hand. A compact combat blade milled from tool steel on a support-course machine and wrapped in grip tape. Damage +4. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Legendary Machined Blade.name: Legendary Machined Blade
Legendary Machined Blade.description: Legendary work, made with a legendary material; there are few like it. A compact combat blade milled from tool steel on a support-course machine and wrapped in grip tape. Damage +6. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Reinforced Vest.name: Reinforced Vest
Reinforced Vest.description: A hero-grade vest of layered aramid panels over a steel trauma plate. Armor +30. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Reinforced Vest.name: Fine Reinforced Vest
Fine Reinforced Vest.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A hero-grade vest of layered aramid panels over a steel trauma plate. Armor +60. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Superior Reinforced Vest.name: Superior Reinforced Vest
Superior Reinforced Vest.description: Superior work, made with a rare material. A hero-grade vest of layered aramid panels over a steel trauma plate. Armor +100. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Masterwork Reinforced Vest.name: Masterwork Reinforced Vest
Masterwork Reinforced Vest.description: Masterwork, made with an exotic material by a master's hand. A hero-grade vest of layered aramid panels over a steel trauma plate. Armor +150. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Legendary Reinforced Vest.name: Legendary Reinforced Vest
Legendary Reinforced Vest.description: Legendary work, made with a legendary material; there are few like it. A hero-grade vest of layered aramid panels over a steel trauma plate. Armor +220. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Recovery Ampoule.name: Recovery Ampoule
Recovery Ampoule.description: A snap-top ampoule of clotting gel and painkiller, mixed in a med lab. Used, it restores a minor amount of health. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Recovery Ampoule.name: Fine Recovery Ampoule
Fine Recovery Ampoule.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A snap-top ampoule of clotting gel and painkiller, mixed in a med lab. Used, it restores a moderate amount of health. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Superior Recovery Ampoule.name: Superior Recovery Ampoule
Superior Recovery Ampoule.description: Superior work, made with a rare material. A snap-top ampoule of clotting gel and painkiller, mixed in a med lab. Used, it restores a strong amount of health. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Masterwork Recovery Ampoule.name: Masterwork Recovery Ampoule
Masterwork Recovery Ampoule.description: Masterwork, made with an exotic material by a master's hand. A snap-top ampoule of clotting gel and painkiller, mixed in a med lab. Used, it restores a potent amount of health. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Legendary Recovery Ampoule.name: Legendary Recovery Ampoule
Legendary Recovery Ampoule.description: Legendary work, made with a legendary material; there are few like it. A snap-top ampoule of clotting gel and painkiller, mixed in a med lab. Used, it restores a legendary amount of health. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Stamina Drink.name: Stamina Drink
Stamina Drink.description: A fizzy electrolyte drink with far too much caffeine. Drunk, it restores a minor amount of Energy. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Stamina Drink.name: Fine Stamina Drink
Fine Stamina Drink.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A fizzy electrolyte drink with far too much caffeine. Drunk, it restores a moderate amount of Energy. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Superior Stamina Drink.name: Superior Stamina Drink
Superior Stamina Drink.description: Superior work, made with a rare material. A fizzy electrolyte drink with far too much caffeine. Drunk, it restores a strong amount of Energy. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Masterwork Stamina Drink.name: Masterwork Stamina Drink
Masterwork Stamina Drink.description: Masterwork, made with an exotic material by a master's hand. A fizzy electrolyte drink with far too much caffeine. Drunk, it restores a potent amount of Energy. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Legendary Stamina Drink.name: Legendary Stamina Drink
Legendary Stamina Drink.description: Legendary work, made with a legendary material; there are few like it. A fizzy electrolyte drink with far too much caffeine. Drunk, it restores a legendary amount of Energy. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Hero Costume.name: Hero Costume
Hero Costume.description: A fitted hero costume of stretch weave with padded panels at the joints. Armor +30. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Hero Costume.name: Fine Hero Costume
Fine Hero Costume.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A fitted hero costume of stretch weave with padded panels at the joints. Armor +60. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Superior Hero Costume.name: Superior Hero Costume
Superior Hero Costume.description: Superior work, made with a rare material. A fitted hero costume of stretch weave with padded panels at the joints. Armor +100. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Masterwork Hero Costume.name: Masterwork Hero Costume
Masterwork Hero Costume.description: Masterwork, made with an exotic material by a master's hand. A fitted hero costume of stretch weave with padded panels at the joints. Armor +150. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Legendary Hero Costume.name: Legendary Hero Costume
Legendary Hero Costume.description: Legendary work, made with a legendary material; there are few like it. A fitted hero costume of stretch weave with padded panels at the joints. Armor +220. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Grip Gloves.name: Grip Gloves
Grip Gloves.description: Close-fitting synthetic gloves with textured palms that keep a grip sure. Armor +30. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Grip Gloves.name: Fine Grip Gloves
Fine Grip Gloves.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. Close-fitting synthetic gloves with textured palms that keep a grip sure. Armor +60. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Superior Grip Gloves.name: Superior Grip Gloves
Superior Grip Gloves.description: Superior work, made with a rare material. Close-fitting synthetic gloves with textured palms that keep a grip sure. Armor +100. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Masterwork Grip Gloves.name: Masterwork Grip Gloves
Masterwork Grip Gloves.description: Masterwork, made with an exotic material by a master's hand. Close-fitting synthetic gloves with textured palms that keep a grip sure. Armor +150. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Legendary Grip Gloves.name: Legendary Grip Gloves
Legendary Grip Gloves.description: Legendary work, made with a legendary material; there are few like it. Close-fitting synthetic gloves with textured palms that keep a grip sure. Armor +220. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Capture Net Mine.name: Capture Net Mine
Capture Net Mine.description: A palm-sized canister that fires a weighted capture net when something trips it. Set, it catches and holds a target with minor force. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Capture Net Mine.name: Fine Capture Net Mine
Fine Capture Net Mine.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A palm-sized canister that fires a weighted capture net when something trips it. Set, it catches and holds a target with moderate force. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Superior Capture Net Mine.name: Superior Capture Net Mine
Superior Capture Net Mine.description: Superior work, made with a rare material. A palm-sized canister that fires a weighted capture net when something trips it. Set, it catches and holds a target with strong force. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Masterwork Capture Net Mine.name: Masterwork Capture Net Mine
Masterwork Capture Net Mine.description: Masterwork, made with an exotic material by a master's hand. A palm-sized canister that fires a weighted capture net when something trips it. Set, it catches and holds a target with potent force. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Legendary Capture Net Mine.name: Legendary Capture Net Mine
Legendary Capture Net Mine.description: Legendary work, made with a legendary material; there are few like it. A palm-sized canister that fires a weighted capture net when something trips it. Set, it catches and holds a target with legendary force. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Support Toolkit.name: Support Toolkit
Support Toolkit.description: A zip case of precision drivers, a multimeter and a soldering pen. Tinkercraft +1. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Fine Support Toolkit.name: Fine Support Toolkit
Fine Support Toolkit.description: Fine work: cleaner, truer and better made than the plain make. A zip case of precision drivers, a multimeter and a soldering pen. Tinkercraft +2. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Superior Support Toolkit.name: Superior Support Toolkit
Superior Support Toolkit.description: Superior work, made with a rare material. A zip case of precision drivers, a multimeter and a soldering pen. Tinkercraft +3. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Masterwork Support Toolkit.name: Masterwork Support Toolkit
Masterwork Support Toolkit.description: Masterwork, made with an exotic material by a master's hand. A zip case of precision drivers, a multimeter and a soldering pen. Tinkercraft +4. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Legendary Support Toolkit.name: Legendary Support Toolkit
Legendary Support Toolkit.description: Legendary work, made with a legendary material; there are few like it. A zip case of precision drivers, a multimeter and a soldering pen. Tinkercraft +5. Made with the Artisan abilities.

Cleo's Glock.name: Cleo's Glock
Cleo's Glock.description: A compact Glock-style semi-automatic pistol carried by Cleo as a professional bounty broker. It occupies the ranged slot, uses compatible ammunition, and rewards deliberate accuracy rather than reckless fire. Its magazine capacity, reloads, noise, legality, and consequences matter; Cleo may prefer warning shots, disabling shots, or nonlethal alternatives when the contract and situation allow.

Jinwoo's Charm Bracelet.name: Jinwoo's Charm Bracelet
Jinwoo's Charm Bracelet.description: A personal bracelet of small charms that helps Jinwoo focus on emotional boundaries and remember meaningful connections. It is not a magical compulsion device and cannot create feelings or consent.

Kiyomi's Paper Kit.name: Kiyomi's Paper Kit
Kiyomi's Paper Kit.description: A prepared case of notebooks, cards, seals, strips, folding paper, ink, clips, and archival sleeves used to construct Kiyomi's paper weapons and battlefield markers. It supports her techniques without creating unlimited material.

Kiyomi's Bandage Roll.name: Kiyomi's Bandage Roll
Kiyomi's Bandage Roll.description: A neatly packed roll of clean bandages carried by Kiyomi for quick first aid during training, investigations, and field incidents. It can cover wounds and stabilize minor injuries, but it is not a substitute for medical treatment and does not restore health by itself.

The Silver Witness.name: The Silver Witness
The Silver Witness.description: An antique silver hand mirror with a black wooden handle. Concept: Acceptance. Ownership transfers only when the current bearer directly offers it and another person knowingly and willingly accepts it. Theft, planting it, or throwing it into someone's hands does not count. The mirror sometimes shows its owner performing actions they have not yet taken; some visions become true and some do not, and the bearer cannot tell which.

The Lovers' Needle.name: The Lovers' Needle
The Lovers' Needle.description: A long crimson sewing needle in a lacquered heart-shaped case, threaded with red cord that never runs out. Concept: Attachment. It recognizes whoever its owner feels the strongest emotional attachment toward; sufficiently changed attachment transfers ownership automatically. Love is not required. Threading it through another person's belonging briefly reveals that person's strongest current attachment, but repeated use confuses the owner's emotions with others'.

The Paper Crown.name: The Paper Crown
The Paper Crown.description: A delicate white paper crown covered in tiny handwritten names. Concept: Belief. It transfers to whoever enough people sincerely believe is its rightful owner. While worn, repeated statements gain supernatural weight; the more people believe a claim, the more reality pushes toward making it true. It is not unlimited reality warping.

The Devil's Chip.name: The Devil's Chip
The Devil's Chip.description: A heavy black casino chip with a gold edge, showing an open hand on one face and a closed fist on the other. Concept: Exchange. It changes owners only through a genuine wager whose stakes both participants understand; the winner becomes its supernatural owner. Clearly stated wagers made while carrying it gain minor enforcement: reality collects declared stakes, but does not guarantee victory.

The Blind Man's Watch.name: The Blind Man's Watch
The Blind Man's Watch.description: An antique black pocket watch with no hands and a closed eye on its face. Concept: Observation. It belongs to whoever directly observed the previous owner relinquish it; an unwitnessed handoff does not transfer ownership. Opening it records roughly ten seconds of the owner's current viewpoint for another person to witness later, while repeated use creates gaps in the owner's own memories of what they saw.

The Bell Without a Tongue.name: The Bell Without a Tongue
The Bell Without a Tongue.description: A small dark bronze hand bell with no internal clapper that rings anyway. Concept: Recognition. It transfers when the current owner speaks the recipient's true intended identity and the recipient answers. The identity need not be a legal name; it must be sincerely recognized by the recipient as themself. Its echo reflects self-perception: confidence is clear, contradiction discordant, and false identity silent.

The Keepsake Box.name: The Keepsake Box
The Keepsake Box.description: A battered wooden jewelry box with empty velvet compartments and scratches from previous owners under its lid. Concept: Sentimental Value. Ownership transfers when someone willingly gives up something of greater personal significance, placing it inside; monetary value does not matter. An item placed inside temporarily manifests an effect shaped by its emotional meaning.

The Final Token.name: The Final Token
The Final Token.description: A thin ivory domino-like tile marked with one red side and one blank side. Concept: Commitment. It transfers after someone receives a clearly understood final opportunity to refuse and proceeds anyway. The owner may designate one clearly stated action as a person's final attempt; if they knowingly proceed and fail, supernatural resistance briefly prevents that exact action from being repeated.

The Petal-Split Blade.name: The Petal-Split Blade
The Petal-Split Blade.description: Doge's existing cursed katana, retained as an unmistakable personal sword rather than redesigned as a gigantic relic. Concept: Inheritance. It cannot be transferred by purchase, theft, wager, contract, declaration, or force. It recognizes a new bearer only when its rightful owner entrusts it to someone with genuine intent to carry forward its purpose. Its Relay significance is trust and chosen succession; its established sword abilities remain intact.

Answering Strike.name: Answering Strike
Answering Strike.description:
After you turn a close attack, answer at once with a precise strike; strongest against a predictable enemy. Moderately improves your next attack made right after a successful defence. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Answering Strike II.name: Answering Strike II
Answering Strike II.description:
Replaces Answering Strike. Your answer comes before the enemy has recovered, so it cannot be blocked. Strongly improves your next attack made right after a successful defence, and it cannot be blocked. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 5]

Answering Strike III.name: Answering Strike III
Answering Strike III.description:
Replaces Answering Strike II. Every defence you succeed at this turn is answered, not just one. Strongly improves every attack you make right after a successful defence this turn, and none can be blocked. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 15]

Assess the Enemy.name: Assess the Enemy
Assess the Enemy.description:
One look and the narrator names an enemy's weakness. Slightly improves your next action against that enemy, and their weakness is revealed. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 3]

Bind and Blade.name: Bind and Blade
Bind and Blade.description:
Combo with a named ally: you bind the target's weapon or attention with a feint and your ally's blade lands where the target is no longer looking; their next attack this turn cannot be blocked. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Blood Rush.name: Blood Rush
Blood Rush.description:
Every wound you take gives you Combat Energy back. Moderately improves your next attack made while wounded, and a wound taken this turn restores Combat Energy. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Trait: Reaver]

Blur Step.name: Blur Step
Blur Step.description:
You spend the whole meter and become hard to see: you act twice this turn and nothing can target you until your next one. Strongly improves both actions this turn, and you cannot be targeted until your next turn. Aftermath: winded, you cannot move until your next turn ends.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 20] [Level: 15]

Brace for It.name: Brace for It
Brace for It.description:
You set yourself against one hit and take half of it, and your Guard comes back with it. Moderately improves your next defensive action, halves one hit, and restores some Guard. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Bulwark]

Breach and Pour.name: Breach and Pour
Breach and Pour.description:
Combo with a named ally: you break the target's Guard and your ally pours through the gap; a hit on your part breaks Guard, and their next attack on that target this turn is strongly improved. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Breach the Guard.name: Breach the Guard
Breach the Guard.description:
Your first attack of a fight breaks the target's Guard on a hit. Moderately improves your opening attack, and a hit breaks Guard. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Vanguard]

Call the Bluff.name: Call the Bluff
Call the Bluff.description:
You name what the enemy is about to do and laugh at it, and they cannot bring themselves to do it. The target's next action fails, and it is spent on you. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 12]

Called Combination.name: Called Combination
Called Combination.description:
Combo with a named ally: you call the sequence and they execute it; their next two actions this turn are improved and the second cannot be countered. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Called Shot.name: Called Shot
Called Shot.description:
You call the strike and an ally's next attack lands where you said. Strongly improves one ally's next attack. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Centered Mind.name: Centered Mind
Centered Mind.description:
You keep hold of what you are doing through a shout, a shove or a wound; nothing interrupts it. Slightly improves your next action, and it cannot be interrupted. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 3]

Channeler's Overdrive.name: Channeler's Overdrive
Channeler's Overdrive.description:
You spend the whole meter and go beyond: for the scene every ability you use is at its strongest, costs nothing, and cannot be interrupted. Strongly improves every ability for the scene, and none costs Combat Energy or can be interrupted. Aftermath: burnout, and your abilities fail for the turn after it ends.
[Skill: Focus 20] [Level: 15]

Charged Blade.name: Charged Blade
Charged Blade.description:
Combo with a named ally: your power rides their weapon or their hands for one action; their next attack is strongly improved and deals your power's kind of damage as well as its own. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Cheap Jeer.name: Cheap Jeer
Cheap Jeer.description:
A loud, cheap insult thrown at one enemy; it does not have to be clever to work. The target's next action is aimed at you and slightly worsened. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Cheap Jeer II.name: Cheap Jeer II
Cheap Jeer II.description:
Replaces Cheap Jeer. The insult lands where it hurts: the target comes at you and forgets their Guard on the way. The target's next action is aimed at you and moderately worsened, and their Guard is reduced. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 5]

Cheap Jeer III.name: Cheap Jeer III
Cheap Jeer III.description:
Replaces Cheap Jeer II. Every jeer is a hook: the target comes at you, drops Guard on the way, and your allies hit them while they are looking at you. The target's next action is aimed at you and strongly worsened, their Guard is reduced, and your allies' next attacks on them are improved. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 15]

Checkmate Play.name: Checkmate Play
Checkmate Play.description:
You have already set the trap: the enemy's next action fails and leaves them open to every ally. Strongly improves your party's next attacks, and the target's next action fails. Costs 3 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 24]

Clean Deflection.name: Clean Deflection
Clean Deflection.description:
You turn one attack aside completely; it does no damage to you. Moderately improves your next defensive action, and the deflected attack does nothing. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 3]

Clean Disengage.name: Clean Disengage
Clean Disengage.description:
You leave melee freely, and no enemy gets a strike at you for it. Moderately improves your next movement out of reach, and it draws no counter. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Skirmisher]

Cleaving Arc.name: Cleaving Arc
Cleaving Arc.description:
One swing through two adjacent enemies; the blow carries into the second. Moderately improves your next attack and applies its result to a second adjacent enemy. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 7]

Close the Gap.name: Close the Gap
Close the Gap.description:
You reach any enemy in the scene this turn, however far or however guarded the way. Moderately improves your next movement, and you arrive in reach of the target you name. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 7]

Combat Breath.name: Combat Breath
Combat Breath.description:
Take a controlled breath in the middle of a fight, restore some Guard and regain Combat Energy; you are vulnerable while you do. Restores Guard and Combat Energy instead of attacking. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Combat Breath II.name: Combat Breath II
Combat Breath II.description:
Replaces Combat Breath. The breath is quicker and you are not open while you take it. Restores Guard and Combat Energy, and leaves you no more vulnerable than before. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 5]

Combat Breath III.name: Combat Breath III
Combat Breath III.description:
Replaces Combat Breath II. One breath restores Guard and Combat Energy fully and steadies an adjacent ally as well. Fully restores your Guard and Combat Energy, restores some of one ally's, and leaves you no more vulnerable than before. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 15]

Conserve the Pool.name: Conserve the Pool
Conserve the Pool.description:
The next ability you use costs one less Combat Energy. Moderately improves your next ability's effectiveness and reduces its cost by one. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 7]

Cutting Remark.name: Cutting Remark
Cutting Remark.description:
You find the thing they cannot stand hearing and say it; composure goes, and a large share of their Guard with it. Moderately worsens the target's next action and costs them a large share of their Guard. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 7]

Decisive Command.name: Decisive Command
Decisive Command.description:
You spend the whole meter on one command: the whole party acts in a single coordinated sequence, every ally's next action improved and none of them counterable. Strongly improves every ally's next action, and none can be countered. Aftermath: you are directing, not fighting, until your next turn ends.
[Skill: Tactics 20] [Level: 15]

Disrupting Jab.name: Disrupting Jab
Disrupting Jab.description:
Strike at an opponent's concentration: a charged ability is interrupted or lands weakened. Slightly improves your next attack, and a hit interrupts what the target was preparing. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Disrupting Jab II.name: Disrupting Jab II
Disrupting Jab II.description:
Replaces Disrupting Jab. The blow interrupts and the target loses the resource they had committed. Moderately improves your next attack, and a hit interrupts the target and costs them what they were spending. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 5]

Disrupting Jab III.name: Disrupting Jab III
Disrupting Jab III.description:
Replaces Disrupting Jab II. A hit interrupts, drains, and puts the target's ability on cooldown as if used. Strongly improves your next attack, and a hit interrupts the target, costs them the resource, and cools their ability. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 15]

Efficient Casting.name: Efficient Casting
Efficient Casting.description:
The next ability you use costs no Combat Energy at all. Strongly improves your next ability, and it costs nothing. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 7]

Evasive Roll.name: Evasive Roll
Evasive Roll.description:
You leave the area an effect is about to fill and take none of it. Strongly improves your next evasion, and an area effect misses you entirely. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 12]

Executioner's Timing.name: Executioner's Timing
Executioner's Timing.description:
Against a wounded or Guard-broken enemy your timing is exact: the strike is decisive. Strongly improves your next attack against a wounded or Guard-broken target, and a hit finishes an ordinary enemy. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 18]

Exploit Terrain.name: Exploit Terrain
Exploit Terrain.description:
The room fights for you: a table is cover, a stair is a choke point, a chandelier is a weapon. Strongly improves your next action that uses the terrain, and the terrain works as you describe. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 12]

Exploit the Opening.name: Exploit the Opening
Exploit the Opening.description:
An enemy who just missed you is open, and you are already in it. Strongly improves your next attack against a target that just missed you, and a hit wounds seriously. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 12]

Feint and Land.name: Feint and Land
Feint and Land.description:
You show one attack and land another; the target cannot block what they did not see. Strongly improves your next attack, and it cannot be blocked. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 7]

Finish the Opening.name: Finish the Opening
Finish the Opening.description:
Combo with a named ally: when your ally has just made an opening on a target, your attack goes into it and cannot be blocked. Strongly improves your next attack on a target an ally set up this turn. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 5] [Level: 2]

Flanking Strike.name: Flanking Strike
Flanking Strike.description:
You attack from the angle the enemy was not covering. Strongly improves your next attack on a target engaged with someone else. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 7]

Guard the Blade.name: Guard the Blade
Guard the Blade.description:
Combo with a named ally: you name them guarded; anything that would interrupt, grab or hit them this turn goes through you first, and their next action is improved. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Guarded Stance.name: Guarded Stance
Guarded Stance.description:
Raise your Guard: incoming damage is reduced and the next enemy who overextends is set up for an answer. Slightly improves your next defensive action and restores some Guard. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Guarded Stance II.name: Guarded Stance II
Guarded Stance II.description:
Replaces Guarded Stance. Your Guard stores part of what it turns and your next counter releases it. Moderately improves your next defensive action, restores Guard, and empowers your next Answering Strike. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 5]

Guarded Stance III.name: Guarded Stance III
Guarded Stance III.description:
Replaces Guarded Stance II. Your Guard covers an adjacent ally too, and both of you release what it stored. Strongly improves your next defensive action, restores Guard for you and one ally, and empowers your next Answering Strike. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 15]

Hammer and Anvil.name: Hammer and Anvil
Hammer and Anvil.description:
Combo with a named ally: you pin the target from the flank while they hit it from the front; the target cannot disengage this turn and both your next attacks are improved. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Heavy Commit.name: Heavy Commit
Heavy Commit.description:
Commit to a heavy blow that deals increased damage and can break Guard, and is easy to punish if it misses. Moderately improves your next attack, and a hit breaks the target's Guard. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Heavy Commit II.name: Heavy Commit II
Heavy Commit II.description:
Replaces Heavy Commit. The heavy blow deals substantially more against a wounded or Guard-broken target, and keeps its risk. Strongly improves your next attack against a wounded or Guard-broken target, and a hit breaks Guard. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 5]

Heavy Commit III.name: Heavy Commit III
Heavy Commit III.description:
Replaces Heavy Commit II. The blow breaks Guard whether or not it lands, and a hit on a Guard-broken target ends an ordinary enemy. Strongly improves your next attack, breaks the target's Guard on any result, and kills an ordinary Guard-broken enemy on a hit. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 15]

Immovable Stance.name: Immovable Stance
Immovable Stance.description:
For the scene nothing knocks you down, moves you or throws you. Strongly improves your next defensive action, and nothing moves you for the scene. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 7]

Impenetrable Guard.name: Impenetrable Guard
Impenetrable Guard.description:
For the scene, one full attack a turn does nothing to you, your choice which. Strongly improves every defensive action for the scene, and one attack per turn is negated. Costs 3 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 24]

Intercept the Blow.name: Intercept the Blow
Intercept the Blow.description:
You take a hit meant for an ally within reach. Moderately improves your next defensive action, and the ally is untouched. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Warden]

Iron Grip.name: Iron Grip
Iron Grip.description:
For the scene nothing takes the weapon or shield from your hands, and a grapple or hold laid on you fails. Strongly improves your next defensive action, and you cannot be disarmed or held for the scene. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 12]

Last Word.name: Last Word
Last Word.description:
The one thing no enemy walks away from, said to the strongest one in the scene: it breaks their Guard and their nerve together. Breaks the target's Guard, and their next action fails. Costs 3 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 24]

Line-Breaker.name: Line-Breaker
Line-Breaker.description:
You spend the whole meter on one advance: every enemy in front of you is struck, and Guard and armour count for nothing against it. Strongly improves your next attack against every enemy in front of you, ignoring Guard and armour. Aftermath: you are exposed, with no Guard until your next turn ends.
[Skill: Combat Technique 20] [Level: 15]

Make the Opening.name: Make the Opening
Make the Opening.description:
Combo with a named ally: you draw the target's guard, attention or footing toward you, and your ally's next action against that target this turn is strongly improved. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 5] [Level: 2]

Mark Target.name: Mark Target
Mark Target.description:
You call a target and the whole party's attacks on it are improved for the scene. Moderately improves your allies' next attacks on the marked enemy. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Master's Stroke.name: Master's Stroke
Master's Stroke.description:
One stroke through Guard, armour and every defensive ability the target has raised, as if none of it were there. Strongly improves your next attack and ignores the target's Guard, armour and defensive abilities. Costs 3 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 24]

Measured Strike.name: Measured Strike
Measured Strike.description:
A strike that never overcommits: it cannot be countered, whatever the result. Moderately improves your next attack, and the target gets no counter to it. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 3]

Momentum Strike.name: Momentum Strike
Momentum Strike.description:
You strike and are gone in one motion, repositioned anywhere within reach before the target turns. Strongly improves your next attack, and you reposition after it. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 12]

Needling Word.name: Needling Word
Needling Word.description:
A jab of words that gets under one enemy's skin: their attention turns to you and their next action is worse for it. Slightly worsens the target's next action, and they aim it at you. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 3]

Pain Is Fuel.name: Pain Is Fuel
Pain Is Fuel.description:
Below half health your every attack is stronger and none of them costs you. Strongly improves your next attack while below half health, and it costs no Combat Energy. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 12]

Parry Anything.name: Parry Anything
Parry Anything.description:
You parry an attack that should not be parryable: an ability, a monster's charge, a hail of missiles. Strongly improves your next defensive action against an ability or an oversized attack, and it is turned. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 18]

Perfect Sequence.name: Perfect Sequence
Perfect Sequence.description:
You spend the whole meter on one sequence: three strikes in a single action, each of which the target must answer or take. Strongly improves your next attack and resolves it as three separate strikes. Aftermath: you cannot raise Guard until your next turn ends.
[Skill: Combat Technique 20] [Level: 15]

Predict the Blow.name: Predict the Blow
Predict the Blow.description:
You read an enemy's next action and the narrator states it; your party may act on it first. Strongly improves your next action, and the enemy's next move is revealed before it happens. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 18]

Quick Sidestep.name: Quick Sidestep
Quick Sidestep.description:
Reposition before an enemy can capitalise: evade, close distance, break line of sight or reach an ally in danger. Slightly improves your next movement or evasion. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Quick Sidestep II.name: Quick Sidestep II
Quick Sidestep II.description:
Replaces Quick Sidestep. The step leaves you with the angle: your next attack or defence after it is improved. Moderately improves your next movement and grants an edge on the action after it. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 5]

Quick Sidestep III.name: Quick Sidestep III
Quick Sidestep III.description:
Replaces Quick Sidestep II. You step twice in one motion, out of reach and back in from a new angle, and no enemy gets a free strike at you for it. Strongly improves your next movement, grants an edge on the action after it, and draws no counter. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 15]

Read the Field.name: Read the Field
Read the Field.description:
You read the field and the narrator names one enemy's weakness and their likely next move. Moderately improves your next action, and the weakness and next move are revealed. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Trait: Strategist]

Reaver's Frenzy.name: Reaver's Frenzy
Reaver's Frenzy.description:
You spend the whole meter and go under: for the scene every attack you make is a Heavy Commit, you feel no wound, and you stop when nothing is standing. Strongly improves every attack for the scene, and each is a Heavy Commit. Aftermath: when it ends you collapse to half Guard and take every wound you ignored.
[Skill: Combat Technique 20] [Level: 15]

Reckless Swing.name: Reckless Swing
Reckless Swing.description:
You throw away your Guard for damage: the blow lands heavy and you are open for it. Strongly improves your next attack, and your Guard drops to nothing until your next turn. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 7]

Recover Guard.name: Recover Guard
Recover Guard.description:
You rebuild your Guard mid-fight without stepping back. Moderately improves your next defensive action and restores your Guard to full. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 7]

Relentless Advance.name: Relentless Advance
Relentless Advance.description:
You attack and advance in one motion; a hit drives the target back a step and you take the ground. Strongly improves your next attack, and a hit pushes the target back. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 7]

Riposte Ready.name: Riposte Ready
Riposte Ready.description:
