When you parry, you answer in the same motion. Moderately improves your next attack made right after a parry. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Duelist]

Set-up Line.name: Set-up Line
Set-up Line.description:
Combo with a named ally: you mock the target into looking at you and your ally's attack comes from where they are not looking; their next attack on that target this turn is strongly improved and cannot be answered. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 5] [Level: 2]

Shaped Effect.name: Shaped Effect
Shaped Effect.description:
Your area effects leave allies untouched and reach exactly whom you name. Strongly improves your next area ability, and no ally is caught in it. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 12]

Shared Blood.name: Shared Blood
Shared Blood.description:
Combo with a named ally: every wound either of you takes this turn feeds you both; your ally and you regain Combat Energy from any hit taken, and their next attack and yours are improved. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Shattering Blow.name: Shattering Blow
Shattering Blow.description:
A blow meant for whatever the enemy is hiding behind: a hit breaks Guard and armour and staggers. Strongly improves your next attack, and a hit breaks Guard and armour and staggers the target. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 12]

Shield and Spear.name: Shield and Spear
Shield and Spear.description:
Combo with a named ally: you cover them while they strike, so their action cannot be interrupted and any hit meant for them this turn lands on your Guard. Moderately improves your ally's next action and your next defence. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 5] [Level: 2]

Shield Wall.name: Shield Wall
Shield Wall.description:
Your Guard covers an adjacent ally for the scene. Strongly improves your next defensive action, and one ally shares your Guard for the scene. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 12]

Split Attention.name: Split Attention
Split Attention.description:
You sustain two effects at once for the scene where another could hold one. Strongly improves your next action and lets two of your ongoing effects run together. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 12]

Steady Channel.name: Steady Channel
Steady Channel.description:
Your focused ability cannot be interrupted this turn. Moderately improves your next channelled or cast ability, and it cannot be interrupted. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Channeler]

Steady Strike.name: Steady Strike
Steady Strike.description:
A reliable attack with a weapon, a fist or whatever is in hand; when it meaningfully connects it builds a little Ultimate Charge. Slightly improves your next attack. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Steady Strike II.name: Steady Strike II
Steady Strike II.description:
Replaces Steady Strike. The strike lands with weight and chips the target's Guard on every hit. Moderately improves your next attack and reduces the target's Guard. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 5]

Steady Strike III.name: Steady Strike III
Steady Strike III.description:
Replaces Steady Strike II. Every strike is placed: it chips Guard, builds Ultimate Charge fast, and a hit on a Guard-broken target wounds seriously. Strongly improves your next attack and reduces the target's Guard. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 15]

Sundering Blow.name: Sundering Blow
Sundering Blow.description:
A strike aimed at the joins: a hit breaks armour and Guard together. Strongly improves your next attack, and a hit breaks the target's Guard and armour. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Combat Technique 12]

Total Focus.name: Total Focus
Total Focus.description:
For the scene no ability of yours can be interrupted and every one costs half. Strongly improves every ability you use for the scene and halves their Combat Energy costs. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 24]

Turn the Crowd.name: Turn the Crowd
Turn the Crowd.description:
A line aimed at the enemy's followers rather than the enemy: the lesser enemies in the scene waver, and the one you point at stops. Worsens every lesser enemy's next action, and one named lesser enemy takes no action next turn. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 18]

Turn the Ground.name: Turn the Ground
Turn the Ground.description:
You turn the terrain against the enemy: a choke point, a collapse, a drop, a fire. Strongly improves your next action that uses terrain, and the terrain acts as you describe. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 12]

Two as One.name: Two as One
Two as One.description:
Combo with a named ally: you and your ally act as one sequence this turn, each action improved and the target unable to answer either until both have landed. Strongly improves both your next actions, and the target gets no counter. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 12] [Level: 8]

Unbreakable Will.name: Unbreakable Will
Unbreakable Will.description:
For the scene you cannot be frightened, charmed, compelled or controlled. Strongly improves your next action against a compulsion, and none takes hold for the scene. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Focus 18]

Unbroken Wall.name: Unbroken Wall
Unbroken Wall.description:
You spend the whole meter and become the wall: for the scene your Guard cannot break, and every hit aimed at an ally within reach lands on you instead. Strongly improves every defensive action for the scene, and your Guard cannot break. Aftermath: you are spent, with no Combat Energy until your next turn ends.
[Skill: Defense 20] [Level: 15]

Untouchable Stride.name: Untouchable Stride
Untouchable Stride.description:
For the scene every ranged attack on you misses and you can be anywhere in the scene each turn. Strongly improves every movement for the scene, and ranged attacks cannot find you. Costs 3 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 24]

Vaulting Step.name: Vaulting Step
Vaulting Step.description:
You clear an obstacle in stride: a table, a wall, a fallen enemy, a gap. Moderately improves your next movement, and the obstacle does not slow you. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 3]

Wall and Hammer.name: Wall and Hammer
Wall and Hammer.description:
Combo with a named ally: your ally strikes from behind your Guard, so every hit aimed at them this turn lands on you and their attack is strongly improved. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Wall Run.name: Wall Run
Wall Run.description:
Vertical is a direction: you run a wall, a pillar, a giant, and fight from where you stop. Strongly improves your next movement, and you reach a position that should be unreachable. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Athletic Mobility 18]

Warden's Aegis.name: Warden's Aegis
Warden's Aegis.description:
You spend the whole meter on the party: every ally's Guard is restored and the next major threat aimed at any of them is negated or sharply reduced. Strongly improves every ally's next defensive action, restores their Guard, and negates the next major threat. Aftermath: the strain is yours, as a serious wound.
[Skill: Defense 20] [Level: 15]

Warden's Line.name: Warden's Line
Warden's Line.description:
Enemies cannot pass you to reach anyone behind you for the scene. Strongly improves your next defensive action, and no enemy passes you for the scene. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 7]

Warden's Mark.name: Warden's Mark
Warden's Mark.description:
You mark an enemy; while they attack anyone but you, they are open to you. Strongly improves your next attack against a marked enemy who attacked someone else. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Defense 12]

Come and Get Me.name: Come and Get Me
Come and Get Me.description:
You make it personal: the enemy you name comes at you and no one else this turn. Moderately improves your next action against them, and their next action is aimed at you. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Provocateur]

Double Volley.name: Double Volley
Double Volley.description:
Two targets, one motion: your ranged attack strikes a second target in the same line or the same breath. Strongly improves your next ranged attack and applies its result to a second target. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 12]

Empty the Quiver.name: Empty the Quiver
Empty the Quiver.description:
You spend the whole meter and fire until nothing is left: every enemy you can see is struck, and cover, distance and Guard count for nothing against it. Strongly improves your next ranged attack against every enemy in sight, ignoring cover and Guard. Aftermath: you are out of shots and out of position, unable to attack at range until your next turn ends.
[Skill: Tactics 20] [Level: 15]

Flush and Fire.name: Flush and Fire
Flush and Fire.description:
Combo with a named ally: your ally drives the target out of cover and into your line; their action this turn is improved, and your next ranged attack on that target is strongly improved and ignores cover. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Patient Shot.name: Patient Shot
Patient Shot.description:
You take the shot on your terms: your ranged attack ignores cover and partial concealment. Moderately improves your next ranged attack, and cover does not protect the target. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Marksman]

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.description:
A shot placed to hold, not to kill: the target cannot move from where it stands. Strongly improves your next ranged attack, and a hit pins the target in place for the turn. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

Play the Room.name: Play the Room
Play the Room.description:
One line for the whole room: every enemy in the scene takes the bait and acts worse for it, while your allies act in the space it opens. Worsens every enemy's next action, and improves every ally's next action. Costs 2 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 12]

Salt in the Wound.name: Salt in the Wound
Salt in the Wound.description:
A wounded or Guard-broken enemy hears exactly what they fear is true, and it stops them where they stand. Strongly worsens a wounded or Guard-broken target, and costs them their next action. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Banter 7]

Straight Man.name: Straight Man
Straight Man.description:
Combo with a named ally: you feed the line and they deliver the punchline; the target is caught looking at you, and your ally's next action against them this turn is strongly improved and cannot be answered. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Skill: Tactics 7]

The Last Laugh.name: The Last Laugh
The Last Laugh.description:
You spend the whole meter on one speech no enemy can let stand: every enemy in the scene turns on you and fights worse for the rest of it, and your allies are free to act. Strongly worsens every enemy's actions for the scene, aims them at you, and improves every ally's actions for the scene. Aftermath: you made every enemy of them yours; until the scene ends, any enemy who reaches you hits you in full, with no Guard.
[Skill: Banter 20] [Level: 15]

Awaken Ultimate.name: Awaken Ultimate
Awaken Ultimate.description:
Reach for the move that is yours alone and make it: use this in a fight or in downtime, name your ultimate, say what it does and which discipline it comes from, and it is created at the scale your level there allows. You hold one created ultimate at most; once it exists, it grows by upgrading it, never by awakening a second. Creates your own ultimate, which then needs the full Ultimate Charge meter like any other. Costs no Combat Energy.
[Level: 1]

Artisan: Craft.name: Artisan: Craft
Artisan: Craft.description:
Make an item from a recipe in your party's Artisan ledger. Click this, then type the recipe's name in square brackets: [Machined Blade]. You need the recipe's materials in hand and you must be at its station (a repair shop or upgrade bay for Forgecraft, a lab, pharmacy or kitchen for Brewcraft, a sewing table or costume room for Clothcraft, a workbench or prototype studio for Tinkercraft); the roll uses the recipe's discipline.
Results: a critical success makes it one quality higher (Fine); a basic success, success or great success makes it at Base; mixed results makes it at Base but uses one extra material; a failure wastes nothing and makes nothing; a critical failure ruins the materials.
When it works, the narration names the finished item in square brackets, [Machined Blade], and that is the moment the ledger records it. Eight starter recipes are known from the first use: Machined Blade, Reinforced Vest, Recovery Ampoule, Stamina Drink, Hero Costume, Grip Gloves, Capture Net Mine and Support Toolkit. Your first Artisan action opens the Artisan Ledger quest, which tracks your progress.
[Level: 1]

Artisan: Design Recipe.name: Artisan: Design Recipe
Artisan: Design Recipe.description:
Invent a recipe of your own and add it to your party's Artisan ledger. Click this, then type the item's name in square brackets, an equals sign, its materials joined with plus signs, and an @ with the station it is made at: [Stormline Baton] = tool steel bar + capacitor + grip tape @ repair shop.
Rules: 2 to 5 materials. The station decides the discipline: a repair shop or counter, upgrade bay, forge, anvil or smithy is Forgecraft; a lab, pharmacy, dispensary, cauldron, still or kitchen is Brewcraft; a sewing table, costume room, tailoring studio, loom or tannery is Clothcraft; a workbench, workshop, prototype studio or tech counter is Tinkercraft. One name per bracket of at most 49 letters (so its Masterwork and Legendary names still fit), no brackets inside it, and no quality word (Fine, Superior, Masterwork, Legendary) in a new name. A designed item starts at Base quality with one theme taken from its words (frost, fire, lightning, venom, shadow, warding, swiftness, healing); its strength is capped by quality, never by the idea, so upgrading is how it grows.
Designing costs nothing and you need not be at the station. The recipe is checked, the narrator names it in square brackets, and that is the moment the ledger records it. A name already in the ledger is refused. Recipes belong to the whole party: anyone can craft them.
[Level: 1]

Artisan: Upgrade.name: Artisan: Upgrade
Artisan: Upgrade.description:
Raise an item you crafted one quality step: Base, Fine, Superior, Masterwork, Legendary. Click this, then type the item's current name in square brackets: [Machined Blade] to make it Fine, [Fine Machined Blade] to make it Superior. The party's ledger must hold the item at that quality.
Each step needs a higher discipline skill (Fine 3, Superior 7, Masterwork 12, Legendary 18), one rarer material (Fine: a refined one, Superior: a rare one, Masterwork: an exotic one, Legendary: a legendary one; the world decides what counts) and the recipe's station; Masterwork and Legendary need a master-grade station. The quest's next step always shows what the next step of your last item needs.
Results: a basic success, success or great success raises it one step; a critical success raises it and saves the material; mixed results raises it but costs a second material; a failure changes nothing and keeps the material; a critical failure loses the material, never the item. The upgraded item replaces the old one and the narration names it, [Fine Machined Blade].
[Level: 1]

Tidal Burst.name: Tidal Burst
Tidal Burst.description: A compressed water blast that knocks targets back and reshapes the battlefield.

Temporal Calculation.name: Temporal Calculation
Temporal Calculation.description: Accelerates perception to read movement patterns and identify openings.

Eclipse Manifestation.name: Eclipse Manifestation
Eclipse Manifestation.description: Gathers darkness into a towering shadow form that shields and strikes.

Slime Genesis.name: Slime Genesis
Slime Genesis.description: Forms a guardian that blocks attacks, creates tools, and mends minor injuries.

Heartstrings.name: Heartstrings
Heartstrings.description: Tugs at a target's emotions, creating attachment, hesitation, or pain.

Flicker Shift.name: Flicker Shift
Flicker Shift.description: Short erratic teleports leave confusing afterimages and create openings.

Siren's Whispers.name: Siren's Whispers
Siren's Whispers.description: Distorts sound to alter perception and stir powerful emotions.

Echo of Agony.name: Echo of Agony
Echo of Agony.description: Amplifies fear through sound, causing hallucinations and debilitating pain.

Feather Drift.name: Feather Drift
Feather Drift.description: Lowers the weight of a person or object, disrupting balance.

Zero Gravity Nap.name: Zero Gravity Nap
Zero Gravity Nap.description: Creates a localized weightless zone where people and objects drift.

Bubble Snare.name: Bubble Snare
Bubble Snare.description: Traps a target inside a reinforced bubble that restricts movement.

Bubble Pop.name: Bubble Pop
Bubble Pop.description: Detonates resilient bubbles with a concussive burst.

Slime Time.name: Slime Time
Slime Time.description: Numeri shouts, "It's slime time!" and unleashes an over-the-top wave of living slime that forms giant shields, restraints, platforms, constructs, and emergency healing material. The technique can transform the battlefield and protect allies, but its versatility makes control difficult.

Bubble Palace: Grand Pop.name: Bubble Palace: Grand Pop
Bubble Palace: Grand Pop.description: Hikari's named ultimate technique: a glittering arena of giant bubbles traps, redirects, stuns, and detonates around targets. It can endanger allies if her focus breaks.

Basic Power Technique.name: Basic Power Technique
Basic Power Technique.description: A reliable, low-output expression of the character's personal power, adapted to that power and identity, resolved through the power skill of how it is used.

Elemental Power: Elemental Shaping.name: Elemental Power: Elemental Shaping
Elemental Power: Elemental Shaping.description: Shape the chosen element into a focused offensive burst, barrier, or practical tool. A fully formed offensive burst deals roughly firearm-tier damage, about 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by element, scale, precision, defenses, available material or energy, Power Strain, and the player's choice. Barriers and tools use their actual defensive or utility effect instead of raw damage.

Mutation Power: Adaptive Trait.name: Mutation Power: Adaptive Trait
Mutation Power: Adaptive Trait.description: Use one chosen physical mutation for a clear advantage, such as enhanced senses, claws, armor, or reach. It cannot create a different mutation and sustained use causes fatigue or unwanted attention.

Psychic Power: Focused Influence.name: Psychic Power: Focused Influence
Psychic Power: Focused Influence.description: Apply the player's chosen psychic effect to one nearby target or simple object. Resistance, distraction, distance, and mental fatigue limit the effect and may increase Power Strain.

Construct Power: Quick Construct.name: Construct Power: Quick Construct
Construct Power: Quick Construct.description: Create one temporary construct shaped by the player's chosen power. It has a specific useful function but limited durability, complexity, duration, and Power Strain tolerance.

Mobility Power: Burst Movement.name: Mobility Power: Burst Movement
Mobility Power: Burst Movement.description: Use the player's chosen movement power for a rapid reposition, escape, or traversal maneuver. Range, destination safety, momentum, and repeated use are limited.

Energy Power: Focused Discharge.name: Energy Power: Focused Discharge
Energy Power: Focused Discharge.description: Release a controlled expression of the player's chosen energy power for offense, defense, or utility. A successful direct offensive discharge deals roughly 40-55 damage when fully powered and connected, modified by energy type, range, control, defenses, available Energy, Power Strain, cooldown, and player intent. Defensive or utility uses resolve by their actual effect.

Cursed Item: First Bargain.name: Cursed Item: First Bargain
Cursed Item: First Bargain.description: Invoke one defined benefit of the player's cursed item. The item exacts its established curse, cost, limitation, or risk, and cannot provide abilities the player did not define.

Technological Hero: Emergency Function.name: Technological Hero: Emergency Function
Technological Hero: Emergency Function.description: Activate one defined function of the player's technology for a meaningful advantage. Battery, heat, maintenance, compatibility, damage, or failure limits its use.

Supernatural: Manifestation.name: Supernatural: Manifestation
Supernatural: Manifestation.description: Use one defined supernatural effect for a practical advantage. Its origin, activation, weakness, cost, and risk must follow the player's chosen supernatural concept.

Vampire: Predatory Surge.name: Vampire: Predatory Surge
Vampire: Predatory Surge.description: Temporarily heighten one defined vampiric capability, such as senses, speed, recovery, or strength. It consumes blood or synthetic blood and may intensify hunger, exposure, or other player-defined weaknesses.

Custom Power: First Expression.name: Custom Power: First Expression
Custom Power: First Expression.description: Use one clearly defined aspect of the player's custom power for a meaningful advantage. It must follow the player's stated activation, strengths, limitations, risks, and starting mastery.

Elemental Power: Minor Shaping.name: Elemental Power: Minor Shaping
Elemental Power: Minor Shaping.description: Cantrip-like expression of the player's chosen element for harmless utility, practice, signaling, or a minor situational edge. It has no cooldown, but cannot create major damage, decisive control, or large-scale defenses; forceful use causes Power Strain and requires the character's normal power ability.

Energy Power: Minor Spark.name: Energy Power: Minor Spark
Energy Power: Minor Spark.description: Cantrip-like expression of the player's chosen energy for a harmless spark, light, signal, tiny charge, or minor utility. It has no cooldown, but stronger output, attacks, and major defenses require the character's normal power ability and may cause Power Strain.

Mobility Power: Careful Step.name: Mobility Power: Careful Step
Mobility Power: Careful Step.description: Cantrip-like use of the player's chosen movement power for small, safe repositioning or ordinary traversal. It has no cooldown, but combat bursts, long distances, unsafe destinations, and repeated strenuous movement require the character's normal power ability and may cause Power Strain.

Mutation Power: Minor Adaptation.name: Mutation Power: Minor Adaptation
Mutation Power: Minor Adaptation.description: Cantrip-like use of one physical mutation for harmless utility or a minor sensory or physical advantage. It has no cooldown, cannot create a different mutation or major combat advantage, and sustained or forceful use causes fatigue or Power Strain.

Psychic Power: Gentle Nudge.name: Psychic Power: Gentle Nudge
Psychic Power: Gentle Nudge.description: Cantrip-like use of the player's defined psychic power on a simple nearby object or willing target for a minor utility effect. It has no cooldown, but resistance, complex control, coercion, combat use, and repeated strain require the character's normal power ability.

Custom Power: Minor Expression.name: Custom Power: Minor Expression
Custom Power: Minor Expression.description: Cantrip-like expression of one harmless, clearly defined aspect of the player's custom power for utility, practice, signaling, or a minor situational edge. It has no cooldown and must follow the player's stated limits; major effects require the normal power ability.

Cursed Item: Minor Invocation.name: Cursed Item: Minor Invocation
Cursed Item: Minor Invocation.description: Cantrip-like invocation of a harmless, player-defined cursed-item function. It has no cooldown, but must still respect the item's established curse, cost, limitation, and risk; major benefits require the normal cursed-item ability.

Technological Hero: Basic Function.name: Technological Hero: Basic Function
Technological Hero: Basic Function.description: Cantrip-like use of one harmless, player-defined technology function for routine utility, diagnostics, signaling, or minor assistance. It has no cooldown, but battery, heat, maintenance, compatibility, and failure limits remain; major functions require the normal technology ability.

Supernatural: Minor Manifestation.name: Supernatural: Minor Manifestation
Supernatural: Minor Manifestation.description: Cantrip-like use of one harmless, player-defined supernatural effect for utility, practice, or signaling. It has no cooldown, but must follow the chosen origin, activation, weakness, cost, and risk; major effects require the normal supernatural ability.

Vampire: Minor Instinct.name: Vampire: Minor Instinct
Vampire: Minor Instinct.description: Cantrip-like use of one defined vampiric capability for harmless senses, presence, or routine utility. It has no cooldown, but hunger, exposure, blood needs, and other established weaknesses remain; major enhancement requires the normal vampire ability.

Probability Engine: Favorable Variance.name: Probability Engine: Favorable Variance
Probability Engine: Favorable Variance.description: Aiko's wearable probability engine nudges one nearby uncertain event toward a favorable result. Each use increases prediction error and device instability.

Impact Banking: Stored Momentum.name: Impact Banking: Stored Momentum
Impact Banking: Stored Momentum.description: Daichi absorbs limited kinetic force and releases it in a controlled action. Excess force causes pain, tremors, or accidental discharge.

Memory Architecture: Familiar Room.name: Memory Architecture: Familiar Room
Memory Architecture: Familiar Room.description: Sora creates a temporary safe space from a remembered place. Emotional memories can cause confusion and mental fatigue.

Vector Choreography Rig: Directed Motion.name: Vector Choreography Rig: Directed Motion
Vector Choreography Rig: Directed Motion.description: Riku's neural rig assigns a short plausible movement pattern to an object or willing ally. Feedback can disrupt his own movement.

Reality Shears: Seam Rend.name: Reality Shears: Seam Rend
Reality Shears: Seam Rend.description: Mika wields giant cursed scissors like a sword, cutting one clear seam through a barrier, construct, connection, or short spatial gap. Unclear cuts may open unstable rifts.

Error Manifestation: Local Glitch.name: Error Manifestation: Local Glitch
Error Manifestation: Local Glitch.description: Noah's haunted implant creates a brief glitch in one nearby machine, power effect, or physical process. It may spread and disable allies.

Probability Engine: House Always Wins.name: Probability Engine: House Always Wins
Probability Engine: House Always Wins.description: Aiko forces a chain of improbable outcomes across a scene. Severe engine instability may create delayed bad luck or system failure.

Memory Architecture: The Place That Neve.name: Memory Architecture: The Place That Never Was
Memory Architecture: The Place That Neve.description: Sora constructs a temporary memory-world to shelter or contain people. Its boundaries blur if resisted, and Sora may lose track of present reality.

Error Manifestation: System Crash.name: Error Manifestation: System Crash
Error Manifestation: System Crash.description: Noah spreads a cascading glitch through a wide area, disrupting machines, powers, and physical processes. Allies may be disabled and the implant damaged.

Ice Power: Absolute Zero Barrier.name: Ice Power: Absolute Zero Barrier
Ice Power: Absolute Zero Barrier.description: Ichi freezes moisture into a layered ice barrier that can shield civilians, divide a battlefield, or redirect an incoming attack. The barrier rewards precise control rather than brute force; heat, sustained pressure, coordinated attacks, and Ichi's Power Strain can break it.

Ice Power: Frost Touch.name: Ice Power: Frost Touch
Ice Power: Frost Touch.description: Cantrip-like expression of Ichi's ice power: frost a surface, chill an object, create a small handhold, preserve a sample, or signal with a brief crystalline mark. It cannot cause major damage or decisive control, and excessive use causes Power Strain.

Construct Power: Tiny Construct.name: Construct Power: Tiny Construct
Construct Power: Tiny Construct.description: A 0-cost cantrip that creates a tiny temporary tool, marker, or simple object. It cannot create a weapon, complex machine, living creature, or durable structure.

No Power: Trained Fundamentals.name: No Power: Trained Fundamentals
No Power: Trained Fundamentals.description: A 0-cost non-powered technique representing practical close-quarters and weapon fundamentals. It grants no supernatural effect and cannot replace training, equipment, judgment, or conditioning.

Gravity Power: Lighten Touch.name: Gravity Power: Lighten Touch
Gravity Power: Lighten Touch.description: A 0-cost cantrip that slightly lightens or weights one small unattended object for a moment, useful for handling, testing, or signaling. It cannot lift people, cause meaningful harm, or overcome substantial resistance.

Shadow Power: Shade Flicker.name: Shadow Power: Shade Flicker
Shadow Power: Shade Flicker.description: A 0-cost cantrip that dims a small area, creates a brief shadow mark, or hides a hand-sized object from casual notice. It cannot create true invisibility, cross distance, or defeat deliberate searching.

Sound Power: Quiet Note.name: Sound Power: Quiet Note
Sound Power: Quiet Note.description: A 0-cost cantrip that produces, alters, or dampens a small sound for a moment. It can signal or mask a minor noise, but cannot deafen, shatter, or control another person.

Time Power: Moment Hold.name: Time Power: Moment Hold
Time Power: Moment Hold.description: A 0-cost cantrip that briefly preserves a tiny unattended object or delays harmless motion for an instant. It cannot freeze people, undo events, or create extra turns.

Probability Power: Lucky Nudge.name: Probability Power: Lucky Nudge
Probability Power: Lucky Nudge.description: A 0-cost cantrip that nudges a trivial, low-stakes chance. It cannot guarantee success or alter important outcomes.

Barrier Power: Palm Ward.name: Barrier Power: Palm Ward
Barrier Power: Palm Ward.description: A 0-cost cantrip that creates a tiny, brief ward around a hand-sized object or surface. It can block a light touch or contain a spill, but cannot stop attacks or protect a person.

Portal Power: Handspan Gate.name: Portal Power: Handspan Gate
Portal Power: Handspan Gate.description: A 0-cost cantrip that opens a handspan-sized view or passage across a very short, visible gap. It cannot transport people or bypass secure barriers.

Illusion Power: Small Misdirection.name: Illusion Power: Small Misdirection
Illusion Power: Small Misdirection.description: A 0-cost cantrip that creates a brief, simple sensory illusion. It cannot cause complex deception, compel belief, or control a target.

Nullification Power: Faint Suppression.name: Nullification Power: Faint Suppression
Nullification Power: Faint Suppression.description: A 0-cost cantrip that briefly dampens a tiny active effect with contact and clear resistance limits. It cannot erase a power or stop a major ability.

Healing Power: Comfort Pulse.name: Healing Power: Comfort Pulse
Healing Power: Comfort Pulse.description: A 0-cost cantrip that eases minor discomfort or helps close a superficial scrape. It cannot restore significant health, reverse death, erase lasting injuries, or remove consequences.

Demonic Contract: Minor Sign.name: Demonic Contract: Minor Sign
Demonic Contract: Minor Sign.description: A 0-cost cantrip that produces a small agreed sign of the player's contract. It provides no unagreed benefit and cannot invent hidden terms, costs, obligations, or consent.

Magical Power: Minor Ritual.name: Magical Power: Minor Ritual
Magical Power: Minor Ritual.description: A 0-cost cantrip for a tiny harmless magical effect defined by the player's practice. It cannot perform major magic without components, preparation, or established limits.

Alien: Astral Core.name: Alien: Astral Core
Alien: Astral Core.description: Channel cosmic energy through the body to create controlled energy blasts, protective barriers, short-range flight, or localized gravity manipulation. Zee's royal bloodline grants unusually precise control, but Earth's atmosphere initially makes the Astral Core unstable. Scale, duration, collateral risk, and Power Strain depend on the chosen effect and Zee's acclimation.

Echo: Resonance Sense.name: Echo: Resonance Sense
Echo: Resonance Sense.description: Echo reads sound, vibration, air movement, and heartbeats to map nearby spaces, track movement through barriers, navigate darkness, and anticipate attacks. It cannot read thoughts or motives. Overwhelming noise, conflicting vibrations, distance, unusual materials, interference, exhaustion, injury, and deliberate countermeasures can reduce or distort the information.

Vice: Enhanced Physique.name: Vice: Enhanced Physique
Vice: Enhanced Physique.description: Vice has enhanced strength, durability, and explosive jumping. She can throw people through walls, survive severe impacts, and reach elevated positions with powerful leaps, but her body is not invulnerable. Sustained force, weapons, powers, injuries, exhaustion, bad landings, and hazardous environments can still hurt or disable her.

Tether: Tension Filaments.name: Tether: Tension Filaments
Tether: Tension Filaments.description: Tether creates nearly invisible energy filaments from her hands and feet. She can anchor them to surfaces, swing through the city, redirect momentum, restrain enemies, catch falling civilians, create trip-lines, and tighten strands into dangerous cutting wires. She can sense movement through anything connected to her threads. Filaments can be disrupted by distance, poor anchors, damage, fatigue, concentration loss, environmental interference, or too many simultaneous connections.

Isabelle Rojas: Hemomancy.name: Isabelle Rojas: Hemomancy
Isabelle Rojas: Hemomancy.description: Shape and manipulate her own blood into temporary weapons, shields, armor, restraints, or precise tools, and use controlled hemomantic techniques to help stabilize or heal an injured person. Isabelle can also deliberately cause pain when she chooses to attack or provoke someone, which makes her control of the same power unsettling. Hemomancy requires available blood, concentration, and physical stamina; overuse risks blood loss, anemia, dizziness, collapse, impaired healing, and lasting injury. Healing is not automatic or unlimited: serious wounds require time, medical judgment, and appropriate treatment, and Isabelle cannot safely heal everyone or erase consequences. Blood constructs are temporary, vulnerable to disruption, and subject to cooldown and scene conditions. Use only with plausible opportunity, consent where appropriate, or an urgent emergency judgment; never assume she hurts or heals the player without player agency.

Parasite: Minor Adaptation.name: Parasite: Minor Adaptation
Parasite: Minor Adaptation.description: Cantrip-like use of one limited parasite-driven body adaptation for harmless utility or a minor sensory or physical advantage. It has no cooldown, cannot create major damage, decisive control, full healing, or large-scale transformation, and sustained use may cause fatigue or Power Strain.

Ryota: Tidal Command.name: Ryota: Tidal Command
Ryota: Tidal Command.description: Ryota shapes and redirects nearby water with precise, rescue-oriented control. He can raise a controlled surge, pull a person from danger, cushion a fall, create a temporary water barrier, steer a small vessel, or form a focused offensive blast. A fully formed direct attack can reach roughly 40-55 damage on a clean connection, modified by available water, scale, range, control, defenses, resource cost, cooldown, and intent. Rescue uses prioritize precision and civilian safety over raw force.

Ryota: Current Reading.name: Ryota: Current Reading
Ryota: Current Reading.description: Ryota senses and interprets water movement, undertow, pressure changes, vessel motion, and disturbances in a connected body of water. It helps him predict hazards and coordinate rescues but does not reveal hidden thoughts, automatically locate people, or guarantee perfect information.

Emi: Arc Drive.name: Emi: Arc Drive
Emi: Arc Drive.description: Emi generates bioelectric energy internally and channels it through her nervous system and muscles to increase reaction speed, movement speed, strength, and striking power. She can release concentrated blasts, electrical arcs, charged punches and kicks, short-range electromagnetic disruption, or defensive electrical fields. A fully formed direct electrical attack can reach roughly 40-55 damage on a clean connection, modified by charge, range, control, defenses, resource cost, cooldown, and intent. Arc Drive burns her body's energy: prolonged or high-output use causes dehydration, muscle spasms, nerve pain, irregular heart rhythm, tremors, and possible temporary paralysis. Maximum output can damage her nervous system and is especially hazardous around civilians or conductive water environments.

Ryota: Vector Crown.name: Ryota: Vector Crown
Ryota: Vector Crown.description: Ryota manipulates kinetic force around his body. He can absorb, redirect, amplify, and release physical momentum to enhance strength, increase movement and jumping speed, redirect attacks, absorb impacts, launch concentrated kinetic blasts, create short-range defensive force barriers, alter direction midair, and propel himself through controlled bursts. He cannot fly indefinitely; he remains airborne by repeatedly redirecting momentum. A fully formed direct kinetic attack can reach roughly 40-55 damage on a clean connection, modified by stored force, scale, range, control, defenses, resource cost, cooldown, and intent. His body cannot store unlimited force. Excessive or simultaneous absorption causes muscle tearing, internal bruising, joint damage, vertigo, nausea, blood-vessel rupture, or unpredictable discharge. He may take unnecessary hits to protect people behind him.

Narrative God: Witnessed Grace.name: Narrative God: Witnessed Grace
Narrative God: Witnessed Grace.description: Amara invokes the meaning of her self-defined god label to steady, clarify, or protect a scene through presence, insight, or carefully chosen words. This is a narrative social ability, not omnipotence: it cannot create miracles, override consent, dictate another character's choices, or grant automatic authority.

Infernal Bruiser: Hellforged Impact.name: Infernal Bruiser: Hellforged Impact
Infernal Bruiser: Hellforged Impact.description: Mel channels her infernal strength into a controlled close-range strike, brace, or burst of endurance. A fully committed offensive hit can reach roughly 40-55 damage on a clean connection, modified by range, leverage, defenses, intent, Power Strain, and her willingness to escalate. It does not force her to attack or override nonviolent choices.

Demonic Contract: Buster Sakes and Petal.name: Demonic Contract: Buster Sakes and Petals
Demonic Contract: Buster Sakes and Petal.description: Mel invokes her demonic contract to summon a Buster Sake and shape or release conjured petals as a distinctive supernatural effect. The Buster Sake and petals follow the contract's established terms and Mel's declared intent; they cannot invent hidden obligations, force consent, or resolve consequences automatically.

African Goddess of Music: Resonant Grace.name: African Goddess of Music: Resonant Grace
African Goddess of Music: Resonant Grace.description: Amara channels her identity as an African goddess of music through rhythm, voice, melody, or percussion to influence the atmosphere, focus attention, support allies, or create a meaningful musical effect. The ability remains bounded by her intent, context, and mastery; it does not grant automatic authority, mind control, or unrestricted miracles.

Demonic Contract: Buster Sword and Porta.name: Demonic Contract: Buster Sword and Portals
Demonic Contract: Buster Sword and Porta.description: Mel invokes her demonic contract to summon a Buster Sword and open bounded portals for movement, positioning, or attacks. Portal size, distance, duration, and destination follow the established contract terms and Mel's declared intent; they cannot create hidden obligations, force consent, bypass every defense, or resolve consequences automatically.

Time Control: Temporal Dominion.name: Time Control: Temporal Dominion
Time Control: Temporal Dominion.description: Keito controls time within a bounded area or target: slowing, hastening, pausing a brief process, or creating a short temporal aftereffect. The effect follows his intent, control, range, scale, and the scene's stakes; it cannot automatically rewrite history, erase consequences, control another character's choices, or guarantee success.

Dead Frame.name: Dead Frame
Dead Frame.description:
Temporarily removes the user from a person's conscious perception without making them invisible. The target's mind stops registering the user, allowing repositioning, escape, stalking, or an attack from an apparently empty moment.

Effects: Dead Frame works on selected observers rather than reality itself. Strong emotional fixation on Seo-jun makes a person harder to erase and may let them notice gaps, movement, or inconsistencies. It does not guarantee safety, silence, perfect stealth, or a successful attack.
Limitations: The user remains physically present and can still be detected by cameras, sensors, indirect evidence, environmental changes, other observers, or a target whose fixation resists the effect. Use is temporary and player-facing consequences remain possible.

Spirit Manifestation: First Manifestatio.name: Spirit Manifestation: First Manifestation
Spirit Manifestation: First Manifestatio.description: Starter offensive ability: temporarily summon the user's level 1 Spirit Manifestation and direct one simple, low-risk offensive expression. The manifestation's player-established name must follow a song-title naming scheme, such as "Purple Rain." The user may yell that name to summon it and may shout a brief attack callout such as “ORA!” or “MUDA!” while using the attack. These are the user's words; the manifestation never speaks. The temporary representation disappears or returns to the user when the summoning ends, the user dismisses it, or its established limits are reached. Its damage, range, control, reliability, and frequency remain limited by the user's power, Power Strain, attention, and established constraints.

BAD HABIT.name: BAD HABIT
BAD HABIT.description: Marisol's original Spirit Manifestation technique: temporarily summon BAD HABIT, a silent level 1 crimson-and-black humanoid spirit bound to her. BAD HABIT can repeat one recent physical action that occurred within roughly 10 meters, such as a punch, kick, pull, or other observable bodily or mechanical motion. It cannot copy supernatural abilities, thoughts, memories, abstract effects, or another power's special result. It holds only one action at a time; complex, powerful, poorly observed, or repeated motions create increased Power Strain and may be inaccurate or fail. Marisol must consciously direct it, and it disappears or returns when dismissed, the summoning ends, her attention breaks, her range or stamina limit is reached, or control becomes unsafe. BAD HABIT never speaks, whispers, narrates, forms independent relationships, or acts as a permanent NPC.

Araignée: Razor Bloom.name: Araignée: Razor Bloom
Araignée: Razor Bloom.description: Araignée unfolds precise blade-like structures from Elise's forearms, fingers, or back, allowing controlled slashes, piercing strikes, and sudden attacks from unusual angles.

Araignée: Vibration Thread.name: Araignée: Vibration Thread
Araignée: Vibration Thread.description: Araignée extends nearly invisible sensory filaments across nearby surfaces. Elise reads disturbances through them, detecting movement, hidden occupants, and changes in tension without relying on ordinary sight.

Araignée: Silk Restraint.name: Araignée: Silk Restraint
Araignée: Silk Restraint.description: Araignée produces thin adhesive tendrils that bind a target, close a route, pull an object within reach, or anchor Elise while climbing. The restraint can be broken by sufficient force or a suitable countermeasure.

Araignée: Eight-Limbed Traverse.name: Araignée: Eight-Limbed Traverse
Araignée: Eight-Limbed Traverse.description: Araignée forms temporary spider-like limbs and gripping structures beneath Elise's clothing, letting her climb walls, cross ceilings, brace against surfaces, or attack from difficult angles.

Araignée: Surgical Overdrive.name: Araignée: Surgical Overdrive
Araignée: Surgical Overdrive.description: Araignée briefly coordinates Elise's muscles, balance, and tendrils with extreme precision, creating a controlled burst of speed and accuracy. Heavy transformation strain follows, and repeated use makes suppression increasingly difficult.

Hush: Quiet Step.name: Hush: Quiet Step
Hush: Quiet Step.description: Seo-jun suppresses the sound and visual rhythm of his movement for a brief approach, repositioning, or escape. It improves genuine stealth but does not make him invisible or erase cameras, scent, physical evidence, or attentive observers.

Hush: Vanishing Angle.name: Hush: Vanishing Angle
Hush: Vanishing Angle.description: Seo-jun exploits a blind spot, obstruction, or moment of distraction to reposition sharply and attack from an unexpected angle. It requires plausible cover or distraction and does not guarantee a hit.

Hush: Fixation Mark.name: Hush: Fixation Mark
Hush: Fixation Mark.description: Seo-jun deliberately captures a target's attention with eye contact, voice, or unsettling provocation. While the target remains focused on him, he can predict their reactions and make Dead Frame harder to notice, but emotionally detached or well-prepared targets may resist.

Hush: Severing Line.name: Hush: Severing Line
Hush: Severing Line.description: Seo-jun makes a precise close-range strike against a vulnerable limb, weapon hand, restraint, cable, or exposed weak point. It is dangerous when delivered from concealment but depends on positioning, timing, and a successful hit.

Turned: Predatory Manifestation.name: Turned: Predatory Manifestation
Turned: Predatory Manifestation.description: Express the player's unique Turned manifestation: living predatory flesh physically connected to the body, not magic, energy, equipment, or a separate creature. It should feel beautiful, unnatural, and unsettling, with glossy crimson, blood-red, black, or deep-violet organic tissue; veins, muscle fibers, membranes, segmented flesh; wet or glass-like surfaces; and sharp biological edges. Its tendrils, tails, tentacles, wings, blades, claws, armored limbs, or branching appendages move like extra limbs, extend and retract rapidly, and visibly regenerate when damaged. It may attack, defend, restrain, reach, or create another player-defined advantage within its established form, limitations, range, and cost. When dismissed it retracts completely into the body, restoring a fully human appearance. Hunger, injury, stress, witnesses, exposure, and loss of control remain meaningful risks.

Cursed Item: First Manifestation.name: Cursed Item: First Manifestation
Cursed Item: First Manifestation.description: Manifest the player's defined cursed item as a real, named equippable inventory item. Use the exact item name chosen by the player; for example, a cursed sword is created as an equippable weapon under that exact name. The item may appear in the hand, emerge from the body, unfold from a mark, or form through another player-defined method. Preserve its exact appearance, function, curse, cost, limitation, and risk. It can be equipped, unequipped, inspected, dropped, or recovered according to world rules. Do not create a generic name, duplicate it unnecessarily, or invent undefined powers. The manifestation has no cooldown and uses Power Strain when activated.

Kitsune: First Foxfire Charm.name: Kitsune: First Foxfire Charm
Kitsune: First Foxfire Charm.description: Starter Kitsune technique: create one player-defined spiritual charm and use it to produce a limited foxfire, mark, ward, distraction, or mobility aid. Foxfire may glow in the player's chosen unnatural color and behaves supernaturally rather than exactly like ordinary fire. The charm's range, duration, effect, target, and combination potential remain limited by Power Strain, attention, positioning, and the player's established boundaries. It cannot permanently increase attributes, rewrite reality, or control another character's actions.

Yōkai: First Manifestation.name: Yōkai: First Manifestation
Yōkai: First Manifestation.description: Starter yōkai technique: express one limited, player-defined supernatural manifestation appropriate to the character's yōkai concept. This may be a brief transformation, spectral feature, sensory effect, elemental expression, spiritual defense, or other established first technique. The player defines its appearance, effect, range, duration, cost, and limits. It cannot invent undefined powers, permanently increase attributes, force another character's actions, or establish universal yōkai rules. It has no cooldown and uses the character's established power resource or constraints.

Alien: Minor Resonance.name: Alien: Minor Resonance
Alien: Minor Resonance.description: Cantrip-like expression of the character's alien nature: a faint glow, a sense that reaches a little past human, a touch of unearthly strength for a small task, a signal only kin can read. It has no cooldown, cannot create damage, decisive control or large-scale effects, and a forceful use requires Astral Core and costs Power Strain.

Barrier Power: Standing Ward.name: Barrier Power: Standing Ward
Barrier Power: Standing Ward.description: Raise a protective, blocking or containing field of the player's defined kind, large enough to cover a person, a doorway or a small crowd, for as long as the user holds it. It stops roughly what a reinforced wall would stop; what passes through is as the player defined. Every hit it takes costs the user Power Strain, and if it breaks the user is stunned for a beat.

Blades: Precision Cut.name: Blades: Precision Cut
Blades: Precision Cut.description: One cut placed to disable rather than to wound broadly: a weapon hand, a strap, a cable, a tendon, a restraint. A success does exactly the declared thing and little else; a failure is a shallow wound or a miss. It is quiet, quick and serious, and a drawn blade is escalation in the eyes of the law and of everyone watching.

Blunt Weapons: Staggering Blow.name: Blunt Weapons: Staggering Blow
Blunt Weapons: Staggering Blow.description: One heavy hit with the character's established impact weapon that leaves the target staggered: on a success they lose their footing or their guard and the next attack on them this exchange is improved, with roughly 25-40 damage that does not bleed. It needs reach and a planted stance, and a nimble target inside the weapon's arc may slip it.

Demonic Contract: Invoked Clause.name: Demonic Contract: Invoked Clause
Demonic Contract: Invoked Clause.description: Invoke one agreed clause of the pact for a meaningful advantage: a strength, a sending, a weapon, a protection, a sight, as the contract defines. A fully committed offensive invocation deals roughly 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by the terms, defenses and Power Strain. The price is paid as the contract says, in the scene or when it is collected; no unagreed benefit, ever.

God: Small Sign.name: God: Small Sign
God: Small Sign.description: Cantrip-like sign of the connection: a candle that lights, a word that lands with more weight than it should, a moment of calm, a mark that the faithful recognise. It has no cooldown, cannot create damage, decisive control or large-scale effects, and a forceful use requires Witnessed Blessing and costs Power Strain.

God: Witnessed Blessing.name: God: Witnessed Blessing
God: Witnessed Blessing.description: Invoke the connection for one clear, witnessed effect of the kind the player defined: a steadiness that spreads, a protection, a revelation, a weight of authority, a touch that mends. A fully committed offensive use deals roughly 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by belief present, the target's defenses and Power Strain; what is granted and what is asked in return are as the player defined.

Gravity Power: Weighted Field.name: Gravity Power: Weighted Field
Gravity Power: Weighted Field.description: Change the weight or pull in a defined area for a few moments: pin, drop, slow, lift or scatter what is inside it. A fully committed offensive use (a crushing weight or a hard fall) deals roughly 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by mass, area, the user's own position, defenses and Power Strain. Anyone in the field is affected unless the user shapes it to spare them; a dropped field drops everything in it.

Hand-to-Hand: Takedown Chain.name: Hand-to-Hand: Takedown Chain
Hand-to-Hand: Takedown Chain.description: A rehearsed sequence that takes a standing opponent to the ground and into a hold: a clean success leaves the target restrained and unable to act until they break free or are released; a partial success takes them down without the hold. It is nonlethal by nature, works only inside arm's reach, and fails against a target that cannot be gripped.

Healing Power: Mending Hands.name: Healing Power: Mending Hands
Healing Power: Mending Hands.description: Close wounds, stop bleeding, steady a failing body or clear a minor condition in one person, by the player's defined means. It restores a meaningful share of lost health, more with time and less under fire; it cannot restore what is gone, reverse death, or heal faster than the body can bear, and it costs the healer Power Strain and Energy.

Illusion Power: Convincing Scene.name: Illusion Power: Convincing Scene
Illusion Power: Convincing Scene.description: Build one illusion big enough to matter: a wall that is not there, a crowd of three, a fire, a face, a sound from the wrong direction. It convinces until touched, contradicted or doubted with reason, holds as long as the user attends to it, and does no harm by itself. What a convinced target does about it is the target's act.

Kitsune: Fox Light.name: Kitsune: Fox Light
Kitsune: Fox Light.description: Cantrip-like foxfire: a glow in the player's chosen colour to light a path, a charm that marks a door, a small glamour on a hem or a lock of hair. It has no cooldown, cannot create damage, decisive control or a lasting ward, and a forceful use requires First Foxfire Charm and costs Power Strain.

Magical Power: First Working.name: Magical Power: First Working
Magical Power: First Working.description: One prepared working of the player's tradition, with its components, words or focus in hand: a bolt, a ward, a binding, a sending, a revealing, as the player defined. A fully formed offensive working deals roughly 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by preparation, components, the target's defenses and Power Strain; wards and utilities resolve by their actual effect. Without its requirements it fails or misfires.

No Power: Practiced Technique.name: No Power: Practiced Technique
No Power: Practiced Technique.description: A trained, rehearsed technique with the character's chosen weapon or unarmed style: a disarm, a takedown, a precise strike, a controlled restraint or a defensive sequence, executed with professional timing. It grants no supernatural effect; its edge is preparation, and a clean connection does roughly weapon-tier damage for the weapon used, modified by skill, positioning, defenses and declared intent.

Nullification Power: Dampening Hold.name: Nullification Power: Dampening Hold
Nullification Power: Dampening Hold.description: Suppress one active power within the player's defined reach for a few moments: a blast fizzles, a construct sags, a flight falters, an illusion thins. A stronger or stranger power resists; holding the suppression costs Power Strain each beat; nothing ordinary (a gun, a fist, a fall) is affected at all.

Parasite: Adaptive Surge.name: Parasite: Adaptive Surge
Parasite: Adaptive Surge.description: The parasite reshapes the host's body for one clear advantage for a few moments: a grown weapon, armored skin, a burst of strength or speed, a new sense. A fully committed offensive use deals roughly 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by the adaptation, the host's condition, defenses and Power Strain. The parasite takes something for it: hunger, pain, a change that does not fully reverse, or a demand.

Portal Power: Doorway.name: Portal Power: Doorway
Portal Power: Doorway.description: Open a person-sized gate between two points inside the power's range, for a few moments: an exit, an entrance, a way to put an ally behind cover or an enemy's attack somewhere else. It needs the far side seen or known as the player defined, carries only what the player's rules allow, and closing it on something is a scene. A bad destination is a consequence.

Power and Hand-to-Hand: Charged Strike.name: Power and Hand-to-Hand: Charged Strike
Power and Hand-to-Hand: Charged Strike.description: A close strike, grapple or throw that carries the character's established power on contact: the physical hit resolves through Close Quarters Combat and the power's effect lands with it, within the power's authored limits and costs. A clean connection deals roughly 40-55 modified by the power, defenses and Power Strain; a miss costs the Energy and nothing else.

Power and Weapons: Conduit Strike.name: Power and Weapons: Conduit Strike
Power and Weapons: Conduit Strike.description: One attack with the character's established weapon that carries their power to the target: the weapon resolves through Weapon Proficiency, the power through its lane, and the effect arrives as one blow within the power's authored limits and costs. A clean connection deals roughly 40-55 modified by weapon, power, defenses and Power Strain. Disarmed, it cannot be used.

Powers Only: Full Commitment.name: Powers Only: Full Commitment
Powers Only: Full Commitment.description: Once an encounter, put everything behind one established power expression: it resolves one band harder than the authored ability says, at the cost of extra Power Strain and the Energy of a full exertion. It cannot exceed the power's defined limits or add an effect the power does not have, and a spent character cannot use it.

Probability Power: Loaded Odds.name: Probability Power: Loaded Odds
Probability Power: Loaded Odds.description: Lean on one uncertain outcome in the scene: an attack that finds the gap, a dodge that finds the footing, a lock that sticks, a ricochet that counts. Raise the outcome one step of success or make a plausible accident fall the user's way; it never guarantees anything and never affects an outcome that was not already possible. The bill comes due later as a coincidence that costs.

Ranged Weapons: Called Shot.name: Ranged Weapons: Called Shot
Ranged Weapons: Called Shot.description: One aimed shot or throw at a declared target point: a weapon hand, a strap, a leg, a device, a light. A success resolves as that choice (the weapon drops, the strap parts, the target cannot run) instead of general damage; a failure is a miss or a hit somewhere else. It needs a clear line, a moment to aim, and the weapon's ammunition.

Shadow Power: Shade Step.name: Shadow Power: Shade Step
Shadow Power: Shade Step.description: Move through, hide within or shape shadow for one clear advantage: a step from one shadow to another in sight, a cloak that takes the user out of notice, a shadow made solid enough to strike or bind. A fully committed shadow strike deals roughly 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by available darkness, light sources, defenses and Power Strain. Steady light breaks it.

Sound Power: Resonant Shout.name: Sound Power: Resonant Shout
Sound Power: Resonant Shout.description: Release, shape or kill sound for one clear effect: a shockwave, a deafening pulse, a silence over a room, a voice carried a block away. A fully committed offensive shout deals roughly 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by range, the user's own ears, defenses and Power Strain, and affects everyone in range unless the player defined a way to spare allies.

Spirit Manifestation: Faint Presence.name: Spirit Manifestation: Faint Presence
Spirit Manifestation: Faint Presence.description: Cantrip-like: the manifestation shows for a moment without fully emerging, a hand, a shape, a pressure in the air, to move a small object, steady the user, signal, or make a point. It has no cooldown, cannot attack, defend or act at range, and a forceful use requires the full manifestation and costs Power Strain.

Time Power: Borrowed Second.name: Time Power: Borrowed Second
Time Power: Borrowed Second.description: Borrow a moment: a burst of personal speed, a brief slowing of a target or space, or a held instant that gives the user one action nobody else gets. A fully committed offensive use (strikes landed inside the window) deals roughly 40-55 on a clean connection, modified by the window's length, defenses and Power Strain. Every borrowed second is paid back afterward as Power Strain and Energy.

Turned: Minor Flesh.name: Turned: Minor Flesh
Turned: Minor Flesh.description: Cantrip-like use of the manifestation: a tendril's tip to reach a shelf, a claw to open a crate, a patch of flesh that takes a scrape, a flicker of the predator's senses. It has no cooldown, cannot attack, restrain or defend at full scale, and a forceful use requires Predatory Manifestation and costs Power Strain.

Yōkai: Small Sign.name: Yōkai: Small Sign
Yōkai: Small Sign.description: Cantrip-like sign of the character's yōkai nature: a trick of the light, a scent, a small change in a reflection, a hint of the true shape for someone who knows. It has no cooldown, cannot create damage, decisive control or a full manifestation, and a forceful use requires First Manifestation and costs Power Strain.

Self-Taught Gear Modification.name: Self-Taught Gear Modification
Self-Taught Gear Modification.description: Use Intelligence, appropriate tools, time, yen, and authored materials to modify the character's own weapons, armor, cursed items, or utility gear. Simple upgrades are accessible with modest Intelligence; advanced tiers require progressively higher Intelligence and better facilities. Higher Intelligence reduces waste and failure risk and improves reliability. A failed or unstable attempt may consume materials, reduce durability, create a temporary defect, or add a cursed consequence. The player chooses the target, intended effect, materials, and whether to proceed; never force an upgrade or its consequences.

Healing Stasis Field.name: Healing Stasis Field
Healing Stasis Field.description: Deploy a technology-based field that stabilizes an injured living target, slows bleeding and deterioration, reduces shock, and holds damaged tissue in a medically useful stasis. It does not instantly restore health, replace surgery or treatment, revive the dead, or erase disease. The field requires line of effect, equipment integrity, power, and time; it may fail or become less effective against unfamiliar biology, severe trauma, interference, or damage to the device.

Alien Research Scanner.name: Alien Research Scanner
Alien Research Scanner.description: Use compact alien research tools to scan biology, materials, energy signatures, technology, and environmental conditions. Results are observations and probabilities rather than automatic truth. Scans require proximity, time, calibration, and an intact device, and unusual powers or deliberate concealment may produce incomplete or misleading data.

Hush: Blackout Crescendo.name: Hush: Blackout Crescendo
Hush: Blackout Crescendo.description: Ultimate ability. Seo-jun turns a prepared area into a brief chain of perceptual blind spots, using timing, cover, fixation, and silence to reposition between observers. Each observer may lose track of him for a moment, but cameras, physical evidence, indirect detection, emotional fixation, and coordinated witnesses can still expose the pattern. The effect does not rewrite reality, guarantee a kill, or force anyone's choices; it requires preparation, concentration, and a plausible environment with interruptions or cover.

Florence: Tri-Range Combat System.name: Florence: Tri-Range Combat System
Florence: Tri-Range Combat System.description: Florence's disciplined fighting framework spanning three ranges: thrown, drawn blade, and unarmed. She moves seamlessly between a katana-like training blade, thrown knives, and close-quarters counters, reading an opponent's stance to close distance or create space. This grants coordination and reads rather than raw damage, and its precise cuts can sever or hamper exposed manifested tissue within its span and rules.

Florence: Target Classification.name: Florence: Target Classification
Florence: Target Classification.description: A rapid tactical assessment that separates what is actually dangerous from what the paperwork claims. Florence gathers posture, movement, exposure, feeding evidence, habitat, and threat signals to classify a target as hostile, frightened, controlled, or misidentified, informing restraint, approach, and escalation without forcing a moral answer.

Yuna: Spring-Lash Maneuvering.name: Yuna: Spring-Lash Maneuvering
Yuna: Spring-Lash Maneuvering.description: Using her four glossy crimson tendrils like organic slingshots, Yuna anchors, grabs, trips, restrains, or launches herself across a field. She can swing, vault, yank targets off-balance, and reposition, enabling rapid infiltration and sudden take-downs built on speed and misdirection rather than raw force.

Yuna: Digital Disruption.name: Yuna: Digital Disruption
Yuna: Digital Disruption.description: A social-engineering maneuver that upends a scene through noise, distraction, and misdirection. Yuna hijacks attention, short-circuits coordination, reads who lies, and turns a hostile moment into confusion, creating openings for the team without violence.

Haruto: Sensory Web Analysis.name: Haruto: Sensory Web Analysis
Haruto: Sensory Web Analysis.description: Unfurling his six black-red sensory appendages, Haruto spreads them across surfaces to sense tiny vibrations, nearby heartbeats, blood traces, and subtle biological changes tied to Turned activity or injury. He maps the evidence of a scene and reads living presence without harming it.

Haruto: Evidence Reconstruction.name: Haruto: Evidence Reconstruction
Haruto: Evidence Reconstruction.description: A disciplined reconstruction that treats emotions as data, never as proof. Haruto assembles timelines, biological markers, witness behavior, and manifestations to determine what plausibly happened, weighing uncertainty and exposing where conclusions outrun evidence.

Tetsuya: Precision Flame Array.name: Tetsuya: Precision Flame Array
Tetsuya: Precision Flame Array.description: Tetsuya's controlled orange-gold flame woven into compressed bursts, narrow cutting jets, temporary walls, heated strikes, and manipulation of existing fire in range. It is especially effective at incinerating exposed manifested tissue and hampering Turned appendages.

Minato: Tidal Burst.name: Minato: Tidal Burst
Minato: Tidal Burst.description: A compressed water blast that knocks targets back and reshapes the battlefield.

Minato: Undertow Step.name: Minato: Undertow Step
Minato: Undertow Step.description: Minato pulls a sheet of water beneath her movement, letting her slide, pivot, or abruptly change direction while throwing nearby opponents off balance.

Minato: Pressure Veil.name: Minato: Pressure Veil
Minato: Pressure Veil.description: A rotating veil of pressurized water that deflects incoming force and briefly shields Minato or an ally. It protects through timing and positioning rather than absolute immunity.

Minato: Crown Current.name: Minato: Crown Current
Minato: Crown Current.description: Minato shapes water into several precise streams that restrain, disarm, or redirect targets and objects. The technique rewards control and theatrical precision.

Minato: Oceanic Heiress.name: Minato: Oceanic Heiress
Minato: Oceanic Heiress.description: Minato unleashes a dramatic surge of water across the scene, combining a powerful blast, battlefield reshaping, and temporary cover. It is her signature finishing display, limited by available water, control, and the scene's consequences.

Maya Ishikawa: Flashbang Toss.name: Maya Ishikawa: Flashbang Toss
Maya Ishikawa: Flashbang Toss.description: Maya throws a compact flashbang that bursts with blinding light and concussive sound, disrupting nearby enemies, breaking their formation, and creating a brief escape window. It can disorient allies or civilians if used carelessly.

Maya Ishikawa: Exit Wedge.name: Maya Ishikawa: Exit Wedge
Maya Ishikawa: Exit Wedge.description: Maya drives into a clustered threat with a brutal shoulder check and controlled strikes, opening a lane through the enemy formation for allies or civilians. The maneuver is strongest when protecting an exit or holding a narrow passage.

Maya Ishikawa: Evidence Lock.name: Maya Ishikawa: Evidence Lock
Maya Ishikawa: Evidence Lock.description: Maya identifies the most dangerous opponent’s weapon, stance, and escape route, then disables or pins their equipment with precise close-quarters tactics. The target loses momentum while Maya marks the safest route for the group.

Maya Ishikawa: Vice Breaker.name: Maya Ishikawa: Vice Breaker
Maya Ishikawa: Vice Breaker.description: Maya commits to a short, explosive takedown that slams one target into the environment and leaves them unable to immediately rejoin the fight. It risks drawing concentrated retaliation toward her.

Isabelle Rojas: Blood Lance.name: Isabelle Rojas: Blood Lance
Isabelle Rojas: Blood Lance.description: Isabelle hardens her own blood into a narrow piercing weapon and launches or thrusts it at an enemy. The attack is precise and frightening, but costs stamina and blood; repeated use risks dizziness, anemia, and collapse.

Isabelle Rojas: Coagulation Snare.name: Isabelle Rojas: Coagulation Snare
Isabelle Rojas: Coagulation Snare.description: Isabelle casts a blood-thread restraint around an enemy’s limb or weapon hand, slowing movement and disrupting attacks. The restraint can be torn or broken, and using it costs concentration and bodily resources.

Isabelle Rojas: Pressure-Point Cut.name: Isabelle Rojas: Pressure-Point Cut
Isabelle Rojas: Pressure-Point Cut.description: Using medical knowledge and a small hemomantic blade, Isabelle targets a tendon, pressure point, or weapon grip to interrupt an enemy without automatically causing lethal injury. The technique requires close range and careful judgment.

Isabelle Rojas: Red Mercy.name: Isabelle Rojas: Red Mercy
Isabelle Rojas: Red Mercy.description: Isabelle turns a spray of her own blood into a violent defensive arc that wounds enemies pressing an ally and creates space around an injured person. It is an emergency technique with serious blood-loss and stamina costs.

Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Telekinetic Ruptur.name: Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Telekinetic Rupture
Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Telekinetic Ruptur.description: Nami’s telekinetic identity violently tears weapons, cover, or loose environmental objects out of alignment and hurls them away from the group. The sudden shift can disarm enemies but risks collateral damage and identity instability.

Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Cryo Lock.name: Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Cryo Lock
Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Cryo Lock.description: Nami manifests cryokinetic force to freeze an enemy’s footing, weapon, or nearby mechanism, slowing pursuit and creating control space. Switching identities or sustaining the effect can cause confusion and loss of control.

Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Veil Shift.name: Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Veil Shift
Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Veil Shift.description: Nami’s invisible identity bends attention away from her for a brief moment, allowing her to reposition, flank, or pull a threatened ally from danger. It is concealment rather than true invulnerability and can fail under focused detection.

Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Fourfold Cataclysm.name: Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Fourfold Cataclysm
Nami “Fourfold” Sato: Fourfold Cataclysm.description: Nami cycles through telekinetic, invisible, cryokinetic, and pyrokinetic manifestations in one unstable sequence, disrupting enemies and reshaping the battlefield. The ultimate can save the group or trigger dangerous identity fragmentation if pushed too far.

Invoker: Invocation Pact.name: Invoker: Invocation Pact
Invoker: Invocation Pact.description: Maintain the supernatural Pact that allows an independent Invocation to manifest, speak, explore, and fight alongside the Invoker. The chosen class and ritual establish the Invocation's identity, legend, abilities, costs, limits, autonomy, and relationship through play. The Pact does not guarantee obedience, safety, heroism, or a chosen legendary figure.

Invoker: Command Seal.name: Invoker: Command Seal
Invoker: Command Seal.description: Consume one of the three scarce Command Seals to issue a specific supernatural command: Force the Invocation to obey, Empower it beyond normal limits, Recall it regardless of distance, or help it Survive an otherwise fatal event. Specific commands are stronger. Seals are difficult to replace and do not erase the Invocation's personhood, judgment, or history.

Invoker: Basic Invocation Magic.name: Invoker: Basic Invocation Magic
Invoker: Basic Invocation Magic.description: Channel Invocation Magic through the Invoker's own body, hands, or equipment while the Invocation is manifested or absent. The player defines a personal magical expression such as an offensive spell, barrier, projectile, binding, reinforcement, support effect, detection technique, weapon enchantment, trap, or short-range movement ability. Its form, range, limits, risks, cost, and reliability must be established through play and remain distinct from the Invocation's abilities and class.

Find the Flaw.name: Find the Flaw
Find the Flaw.description:
You study one enemy for a moment and the narrator names a flaw in their guard, armour or power that your next blow can use. Moderately improves your next attack on them, and a hit there counts as striking their weakness. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Analyst]

Sixth Sense.name: Sixth Sense
Sixth Sense.description:
You read the next attack before it starts. Moderately improves your next defence or dodge, and if it succeeds you end up somewhere better: behind cover, beside an ally or at the attacker's flank. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Sentinel]

Rally Call.name: Rally Call
Rally Call.description:
You call one ally's next move out loud. Moderately improves that ally's next action, and they regain 1 Combat Energy. Costs 1 Combat Energy.
[Trait: Commander]

Blade Invocation: Crossed Steel.name: Blade Invocation: Crossed Steel
Blade Invocation: Crossed Steel.description: You open the exchange and your Blade Invocation finishes it. For one exchange your Invocation Magic reinforces your arms or weapon while you force a guard wide, a weapon down or a stance broken, and a willing Blade Invocation takes the opening in the same breath. Works only when the Invocation is manifested, close enough to act and chooses to follow your lead; at low Bond it may take its own opening instead, or none. The opening is yours to create; the blow is its to land. Costs 1 Combat Energy and light Power Strain.

Lancer Invocation: Line of the Spear.name: Lancer Invocation: Line of the Spear
Lancer Invocation: Line of the Spear.description: You lay a ward along a line and your Lancer Invocation holds it with reach. Until the scene changes or you move the ward, anyone crossing that line is met by the Lancer's reach first and your ward second, and civilians behind it get a moment to get clear. It holds a line, not a room; a flier, a teleporter or a wall-breaker goes around it. Works only while the Invocation is manifested and agrees the line is worth holding. Costs 1 Combat Energy and steady Power Strain while it stands.

Marksman Invocation: Pact Mark.name: Marksman Invocation: Pact Mark
Marksman Invocation: Pact Mark.description: You touch or see a target and lay a Pact Mark on it that only you and your Marksman Invocation can perceive. While it lasts you both know roughly where the target is through cover and crowds, and the Invocation's next shot at it finds the line it needed. One mark at a time, it fades by the end of the scene, and a target who understands Invoker sigils can feel it and try to break it. Costs 1 Combat Energy.

Rider Invocation: Pact Stirrup.name: Rider Invocation: Pact Stirrup
Rider Invocation: Pact Stirrup.description: You anchor yourself to your Rider Invocation through the Pact and move with its charge, its mount or its vehicle: you are carried, pulled or thrown alongside it across a street, a rooftop gap or a fight, and land where it lands. It moves the two of you, not a crowd; the Invocation chooses the path and can refuse a route it thinks will get you killed. Works only while it is manifested. Costs 1 Combat Energy and light Power Strain.

Caster Invocation: Shared Circle.name: Caster Invocation: Shared Circle
Caster Invocation: Shared Circle.description: You and your Caster Invocation build one working together: your Invocation Magic and its craft laid into a single circle, ward, binding or blast stronger than either alone, of the kind both of you can do. Both of you take the strain, the working takes the time a real working takes, and a disrupted circle backlashes on both. It cannot do what neither of you could; it does what you could, better. Works only while the Invocation is manifested and willing. Costs 2 Combat Energy and real Power Strain.

Stalker Invocation: Seal Silence.name: Stalker Invocation: Seal Silence
Stalker Invocation: Seal Silence.description: The Pact goes quiet. For a short stretch you and your Stalker Invocation share a sense (sight or hearing) and your presence dims together: footsteps, breath, the Seal on your hand. It covers a close approach, an escape or an ambush set together, not a walk through a lit lobby; cameras, dogs and alert guards still catch what moves wrong. Works only while the Invocation is manifested and wants the same outcome. Costs 1 Combat Energy.

Berserker Invocation: Leash of Will.name: Berserker Invocation: Leash of Will
Berserker Invocation: Leash of Will.description: You hold the Pact taut while your Berserker Invocation tears loose: it hits harder and ignores pain for a few exchanges, and your will on the Pact keeps it telling friend from foe. The strain lands on you, and if you lose your grip (a failed check, a heavy hit, too much Power Strain) the leash slips and it fights on its own judgment until it calms or you recall it. At low Bond it may refuse the leash entirely. Costs 2 Combat Energy and heavy Power Strain.

No Power: Opening Read.name: No Power: Opening Read
No Power: Opening Read.description: The character spends a moment watching one opponent, then commits to a counter timed to that opponent's tell: a strike as the blast winds up, a disarm as the reach overextends, a sweep as they plant to use their power.
