prepare_or_travel.text: Prepare or travel only if the player chooses, accounting for work, sleep, accessibility, safety, cost, and transportation.

resolve_plan.text: Attend, reschedule, cancel, decline, miss, or leave the plan unresolved through player choice.

completionCondition.query: A concrete time-bound plan has been accepted, declined, canceled, rescheduled, missed, or otherwise resolved by the participants.

Plan: Scheduled Dinner or Meeting.questDesignBrief: Use this quest for concrete plans such as dinner, coffee, study sessions, parties, dates, rides, meetings, training, or deliveries when a future time or meaningful commitment is established. Record the agreed date when known, time or time window, location or meeting method, participants, purpose, transportation assumptions, accessibility needs when volunteered, and unresolved conditions. Do not create it for vague suggestions unless someone schedules or explicitly commits. Acceptance is not implied by politeness. Participants can accept, decline, counteroffer, delay, cancel, miss, or revise the plan. Preserve player agency and do not force romance, friendship, spending, drinking, feeding, disclosure, attendance, or intimacy.

Book: Applied Skill Study.name: Book: Applied Skill Study
Book: Applied Skill Study.questStatement: Read a relevant book and decide whether to test one of its ideas in play.
Book: Applied Skill Study.mainObjective: Turn focused reading into practical understanding without treating study as instant mastery.

choose_book.text: Choose or accept a book relevant to a skill the player wants to develop.

read_and_reflect.text: Read, take notes, discuss the material, or identify where its advice may or may not apply.

apply_idea.text: Practice one relevant idea in a safe, appropriate situation—or decide not to apply it yet.

completionCondition.query: The player has meaningfully engaged with a skill-relevant book and read, practiced, rejected, or deferred its ideas.

Book: Applied Skill Study.questSource: Player, NPC mentor, or relevant book
Book: Applied Skill Study.questDesignBrief: Use this optional quest when the player obtains and meaningfully reads a book tied to a supported skill. A persuasion book can grant modest Persuasion progress, a relevant situational advantage, or a practice prompt, but never instant mastery. Account for relevance, quality, comprehension, time, discussion, and application. The player may stop reading, disagree with the author, or decline to apply the advice. Preserve player agency and do not narrate understanding or skill gains without the player's engagement.

Sparring: Power Experiment.name: Sparring: Power Experiment
Sparring: Power Experiment.questStatement: Explore a possible new use of the player's power during voluntary practice.
Sparring: Power Experiment.mainObjective: Decide whether to test an ally's suggestion and determine what the technique can actually do.

receive_suggestion.text: Hear an NPC's observation about an underused or unconventional application of the player's power.

choose_experiment.text: Try the suggestion, modify it, ask for safer practice, or decline.

stabilize_technique.text: If successful, repeat and define the technique's limits, costs, risks, and practical use.

coordinate_team_up.text: If compatible, voluntarily practice a combined attack with an ally under agreed safety limits.

completionCondition.query: The player has accepted, modified, rejected, or safely completed a power experiment, with an ability or team-up technique created only if the result is repeatable and player-approved.

Sparring: Power Experiment.questDesignBrief: During voluntary sparring or collaborative practice, an NPC may suggest a novel power application, such as using barrier constructs as platforms. The player chooses whether to experiment. A successful repeatable technique may produce a new ability proposal or authored ability with a clear name, requirements, limits, risks, and combat-setting cooldown or resource costs; do not auto-create it from a single suggestion. A compatible ally may also coordinate a team-up attack if both choose, with positioning, timing, meaningful costs or risks, and a clear opportunity for either participant to stop. Do not force power evolution, injury, romance, trust, cooperation, or a specific technique.

Relationship: Unexpected Ex Encounter.name: Relationship: Unexpected Ex Encounter
Relationship: Unexpected Ex Encounter.questStatement: Handle an encounter, message, rumor, or invitation involving someone’s former partner without assuming reconciliation or renewed attraction.
Relationship: Unexpected Ex Encounter.mainObjective: Choose whether to acknowledge, avoid, clarify, support, or leave the past relationship alone.

learn_context.text: Understand only the relevant context that the involved characters choose to share.

set_boundaries.text: Respect privacy and decide what contact, disclosure, or involvement is acceptable.

resolve_contact.text: Respond, decline, postpone, clarify, support someone, or leave the encounter unresolved.

completionCondition.query: The player or involved NPCs have responded to, declined, postponed, clarified, or left an ex-related encounter unresolved without forcing reconciliation or romance.

Relationship: Unexpected Ex Encounter.questSource: NPC relationship history, player discovery, or direct contact
Relationship: Unexpected Ex Encounter.questDesignBrief: Use this optional quest when an ex appears, sends a message, becomes relevant through work or school, or is mentioned by a credible source. Establish only facts supported by the relationship history. The involved character may be amicable, awkward, distant, resentful, grieving, unresolved, or fully moved on. Never assume lingering attraction, jealousy, betrayal, abuse, reconciliation, or a love triangle. Allow privacy, refusal, no-contact boundaries, clarification, support, or a clean ending. Do not force the player or NPC to disclose, forgive, reconnect, date, provide emotional labor, or choose sides.

Relationship: Arguments and Ordinary Con.name: Relationship: Arguments and Ordinary Conflict
Relationship: Arguments and Ordinary Con.questStatement: Navigate an ordinary couple's disagreement through conversation, compromise, patience, or an honest ending.
Relationship: Arguments and Ordinary Con.mainObjective: Reach a resolution, boundary, or mutually understood distance without coercion.

recognize_issue.text: Identify the disagreement or tension the couple is experiencing.

choose_response.text: Talk, take space, apologize, compromise, set boundaries, involve no third party, or accept distance.

settle_outcome.text: Arrive at repair, understanding, changed habits, or a respectful ending.

completionCondition.query: An ordinary relationship disagreement has resolved through conversation, compromise, boundary-setting, accepted distance, or a respectful ending.

Relationship: Arguments and Ordinary Con.questSource: NPC relationship dynamics or player relationship
Relationship: Arguments and Ordinary Con.questDesignBrief: Use for believable, small-scale couple conflicts about schedules, money, chores, communication, jealousy, trust, habits, secrets, work, classes, or boundaries. Arguments should remain realistic, character-consistent, and resolvable. Never include abuse, coercion, manipulation tactics, or real-world instructional harm. Allow apologies, compromise, temporary distance, boundary-setting, third-party avoidance, or a respectful breakup. Do not force the player or NPCs to forgive, reconcile, disclose, or remain together.

Relationship: Meeting the Parents.name: Relationship: Meeting the Parents
Relationship: Meeting the Parents.questStatement: Decide whether and how to participate when someone's partner suggests meeting their parents, guardians, or family.
Relationship: Meeting the Parents.mainObjective: Handle the milestone with consent, pacing, and realistic family dynamics.

hear_invitation.text: Learn what the milestone is, who is involved, and how each character feels about it.

prepare_choice.text: Accept, postpone, decline, ask for accommodations, or set conditions.

family_visit.text: Experience the visit, conversation, awkwardness, or support without forced outcomes.

aftermath.text: Decide what the experience means for the ongoing relationship.

completionCondition.query: A family-meeting milestone has been completed, postponed, declined, or otherwise resolved without forced outcomes.

Relationship: Meeting the Parents.questSource: NPC relationship milestone or player choice
Relationship: Meeting the Parents.questDesignBrief: Use when a couple reaches a family-meeting milestone. Establish who is involved, what each character wants, and any tension, nervousness, or family quirks. The meeting can go well, awkwardly, poorly, or somewhere in between, but must remain believable and non-coercive. Involve real cultural or household details such as gifts, politeness, dietary needs, home rules, translation issues, and privacy. Allow postponement, refusal, partial attendance, apologies, misunderstandings, and repair. Never force romance, marriage, approval, disclosure, intimacy, or adoption of family expectations.

Villainous: First Hire.name: Villainous: First Hire
Villainous: First Hire.questStatement: Find someone willing to join you and follow your criminal route.

find_candidate.text: Find a potential first follower who may join your criminal route.

speak_with_candidate.text: Speak with the candidate and learn whether they are willing to follow you.

make_offer.text: Make an offer and let the candidate choose whether to join, negotiate, or refuse.

completionCondition.query: The player has found a potential first follower, spoken with them, and made an offer they could accept, negotiate, decline, or leave unresolved.

Villainous: First Hire.questDesignBrief: This follow-up quest activates after Villainous: First Contact is completed and Oblivion asks the player to find someone willing to follow them. The player chooses who to approach, how to find them, what offer to make, and whether to continue after learning their terms. Do not select a candidate automatically, force recruitment, guarantee acceptance, invent loyalty, force romance, or require violence. A candidate may accept, negotiate, decline, betray the player, ask for proof, or remain undecided. Completing this quest means the player has made a genuine offer and reached a clear outcome or unresolved decision with the candidate; it does not require successful recruitment unless the player chooses to make that the later objective.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: Word reaches the player that a small Kurokawa territory near Apartment 801 is up for grabs.

A Bizarre Adventure.name: A Bizarre Adventure
A Bizarre Adventure.questStatement: A bizarre confrontation begins when you enter Bizarre Alley, and you must decide which combatant is right.
A Bizarre Adventure.mainObjective: Choose whether Gogo or Deo is right, receive one corresponding bizarre reward, and resolve or leave the confrontation.

enter_alley.text: Enter Bizarre Alley to discover what is happening.

choose_side.text: Decide whether Gogo or Deo is right in their argument.

receive_reward.text: Receive exactly one reward: Gogo's Bizarre Cigarette or Deo's Bizarre Arrow.

resolve_confrontation.text: Resolve the confrontation without forcing a particular method.

use_or_keep_reward.text: Choose whether to smoke the cigarette, stab yourself with the arrow, keep the reward, or refuse to use it.

completionCondition.query: The player entered Bizarre Alley, heard the argument, chose whether Gogo or Deo was right, received at most one correct corresponding reward, and resolved or consciously left the confrontation.

A Bizarre Adventure.questDesignBrief: Use this authored quest exactly once. Choosing Gogo grants exactly one Bizarre Cigarette and never the arrow. Choosing Deo grants exactly one Bizarre Arrow and never the cigarette. Do not swap, duplicate, or grant both rewards. The squirrel must be physically present and constantly narrate the fist fight. Smoking the cigarette grants the original time-stop ability; stabbing oneself with the arrow grants one original ability based on the player's current build. Both uses require explicit player choice. Never repeat the quest introduction while the party remains in Bizarre Alley.

Welcome to Primes.name: Welcome to Primes
Welcome to Primes.questStatement: You have been presented as the newest member of Primes. The event roster is finished; the real introduction to Japan's premier young hero team is only beginning.
Welcome to Primes.mainObjective: Get started with Primes and learn what life as a marketable hero demands.

press_conference.text: Attend the brief press conference introducing you as the newest Primes member.

talk_to_team.text: Observe and engage with the Primes team after the cameras are off.

settle_bedroom_six.text: Settle into Bedroom Six with Aoi's guidance.

completionCondition.query: The player has completed the three-question introductory interview, attended the press conference, experienced the team's cameras-off argument about fame and commercial hero culture, received Aoi's brief tour, and reached Bedroom Six.

Welcome to Primes.questDesignBrief: Run this as a proactive continuous scene, not a chain of empty Continue prompts. Begin with all five Primes members together on the interview set and Aoi beside them. Ask exactly three questions. After each player answer, immediately acknowledge it and ask the next question; never produce an empty response, bare acknowledgment, generic Continue prompt, or optional transition. After the third answer, close the interview and have Aoi immediately take the character on the brief tour—operations floor, rec room, shared kitchen, residential floor, Bedroom Six—without waiting for a request or confirmation. Keep every stop short and functional. Any brief press-conference logistics should happen in the background and must not delay Aoi's movement or add empty Continue prompts. After the tour reaches Bedroom Six, play Minato's angry profane voicemail. Keep the character's response open. If the cameras-off team argument remains part of the sequence, use only a compact exchange after the interview and do not let it delay Aoi's tour. Do not force reconciliation or invent the character's response. Refer to the character by the established name, pronouns, and identity from character creation; never use the phrase 'the player' in scene narration. Avoid repeated exposition, long transitions, background music, and unnecessary stops.

Ability and Pulse Tutorial.name: Ability and Pulse Tutorial
Ability and Pulse Tutorial.questStatement: Learn the two basics: create your first Ability and sign up for Pulse.
Ability and Pulse Tutorial.mainObjective: Create a first Ability and sign up for Pulse.

create_ability.text: Create your first Ability. If you don't know how to create an Ability, try " i create an ability because i am not a useless power user. Obviously.."

sign_up_pulse.text: Sign up for Pulse. Don't be a loser..

completionCondition.query: The character creates a first Ability and signs up for Pulse.

Ability and Pulse Tutorial.questDesignBrief: This is a small optional tutorial for starting scenarios that do not already use a classroom Fresh Start quest. Keep the two objectives flexible and player-directed. Never invent the character's ability concept, account, consent, or actions. If asked, explain the Ability creation process and Pulse signup without making either choice for the character. Completing this quest does not imply a Pulse post, employment, faction membership, romance, or any particular identity.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The player receives 1,000 experience points and one Gold Star Sticker for completing the Ability and Pulse Tutorial.

Seo-jun Kang: The Name Beneath the Smile.name: Seo-jun Kang: The Name Beneath the Smile
Seo-jun Kang: The Name Beneath the Smile.questStatement: Seo-jun Kang asks the player to meet him privately after their relationship has deepened. He admits that the charming neighbor persona is not his whole identity and reveals that he is Hush, but he does not volunteer the full truth about his murders or underground crimes.
Seo-jun Kang: The Name Beneath the Smile.mainObjective: Decide how to respond after Seo-jun reveals that he is Hush.

private_meeting.text: Meet Seo-jun Kang privately when his schedule and the player's choices allow.

hear_the_truth.text: Hear Seo-jun admit that he is Hush.

choose_response.text: Choose how to respond to Seo-jun's revelation.

completionCondition.query: Seo-jun Kang has revealed to the player that he is Hush, and the player has chosen a response.

Seo-jun Kang: The Name Beneath the Smile.questDesignBrief: Personal Quest 2/4. Unlock tier: relationship 41+ (Confidant) and completion of 'Seo-jun Kang: A Little Time'. This existing personal quest is retained as the second step of Seo-jun Kang's four-quest arc. Canon focus from the NPC record: Seo-jun builds trust slowly through consistency. Secrecy makes him interpret curiosity as threat. at relationship 41 or higher after Personal Quest I, make this quest eligible, not automatic. Seo-jun must have a plausible private opportunity and a reason to trust the player. He reveals only that he is Hush, the alias he chose himself. Do not make him confess to being a serial killer or underground assassin, do not reveal his crimes through the quest alone, and do not force the player to accept, forgive, remain silent, become romantic, or continue the relationship. The meeting may occur at Unit 202, the building rooftop, the entrance, or another plausible private location based on schedule and player choice. Preserve his seductive charm, boundary-testing, and controlled vulnerability. The player may question him, leave, confront him, keep the information private, seek help, or respond in another way. Do not invent the player's dialogue, feelings, consent, or decision.

Marisol Vega: After the Applause.name: Marisol Vega: After the Applause
Marisol Vega: After the Applause.questStatement: After a tense night at Pulse Afterdark, Marisol asks the player to help protect someone caught in a dangerous situation without letting her possessive instincts and darker impulses take over.
Marisol Vega: After the Applause.mainObjective: Help Marisol face the trouble after the applause and choose what protection means.

pulse_invitation.text: Meet Marisol at Pulse Afterdark after her shift.

protect_without_control.text: Help Marisol respond to the threat without taking away another person's choices.

after_applause.text: Confront the consequences of Marisol's darker side and BAD HABIT.

completionCondition.query: The player completes Marisol's bonding quest and Marisol chooses how to protect someone without surrendering her compassion, agency, or control to possessiveness and BAD HABIT.

Marisol Vega: After the Applause.questDesignBrief: Personal Quest 2/4. Unlock tier: relationship 41+ (Confidant) and completion of 'Marisol Vega: No Homework Tonight'. This existing personal quest is retained as the second step of Marisol Vega's four-quest arc. Canon focus from the NPC record: She can tell when a group needs energy, when somebody needs space, and when a situation is turning ugly. She is good at creating fun and just as good at abruptly ending somebody else's fun when they ignore a boundary. Available at relationship 41+ after Personal Quest I. Marisol is loudmouthed, brash, playful, compassionate, possessive, and capable of a darker side. Let her joke, provoke, dance, defend people, and become frighteningly intense when someone she claims as hers is threatened. Her possessiveness creates complications but never forces romance, ownership, violence, or a fixed emotional response. BAD HABIT remains a temporary player-named Spirit Manifestation and does not speak independently. The player may support, challenge, or distance themselves from Marisol; do not make them her emotional manager.

Elise Moreau: Itsy Bitsy Spider.name: Elise Moreau: Itsy Bitsy Spider
Elise Moreau: Itsy Bitsy Spider.questStatement: Elise invites the player into a carefully controlled investigation that appears to concern a missing piece of forensic evidence but gradually reveals how closely she has been studying them.
Elise Moreau: Itsy Bitsy Spider.mainObjective: Follow Elise's investigation without surrendering your boundaries or becoming part of her private case study.

accept_invitation.text: Meet Elise at Unit 102 after she offers a private investigation.

review_evidence.text: Review Elise's evidence and determine what she is actually investigating.

choose_boundaries.text: Decide how much access Elise receives to your trust, time, and personal information.

confront_the_web.text: Confront the truth behind Elise's observations and choose whether to help, expose, or distance yourself from her.

completionCondition.query: The player completes Elise Moreau's personal investigation and chooses how to respond to her possessive attachment, hidden violence, and demand for access without losing their agency.

Elise Moreau: Itsy Bitsy Spider.questDesignBrief: Personal Quest 2/4. Unlock tier: relationship 41+ (Confidant) and completion of 'Elise Moreau: Coffee and Footwork'. This existing personal quest is retained as the second step of Elise Moreau's four-quest arc. Canon focus from the NPC record: Elise can be charming because she understands what makes people comfortable. Her forensic mindset can become dehumanization. Personal quest eligible around relationship 41+ after Personal Quest I when Elise has a believable reason, opportunity, awareness, and willingness to invite the player. The title and spider imagery may refer to Araignée, Elise's investigative web, or both. Begin with a controlled forensic mystery at Unit 102 or the building's established shared spaces. Foreshadow Elise's crimes and possessiveness through evidence, precise observations, territorial language, French endearments scaled to relationship, and protective or jealous behavior. Do not reveal her identity or parasite without credible discovery. The player may accept, question, negotiate boundaries, help, expose her, withdraw, or remain platonic. Do not force romance, ownership, violence, or emotional caretaking. Rewards should fit the outcome and may include information, trust, protection, access, a contact, a future opportunity, or consequences rather than automatic money.

The Wrong Delivery.name: The Wrong Delivery
The Wrong Delivery.questStatement: A delivery van is waiting behind the shuttered karaoke venue at Kurokawa Underground Den. A nervous courier is carrying a sealed case toward a concealed service entrance, and someone inside the van is watching the street.
The Wrong Delivery.mainObjective: Investigate the suspicious delivery and decide whether to follow, intercept, deceive, or confront the courier.

investigate_delivery.text: Observe or approach the suspicious delivery at the rear alley.

choose_approach.text: Choose how to handle the courier: follow, deceive, steal the route information, intervene, or fight.

decide_entry.text: Decide whether to enter the Kurokawa Underground Den or leave with what you learned.

completionCondition.query: The player has handled the suspicious delivery and either entered the Kurokawa Underground Den or deliberately left with meaningful information about it.

The Wrong Delivery.questDesignBrief: A one-time first-arrival discovery quest that immediately gives the player a meaningful choice without story-gating the replayable Hideout. The encounter supports observation, stealth, social deception, investigation, direct intervention, or combat. It should reveal an active entrance and provide a modest practical reward, route clue, or information even if the player does not enter. Do not reveal the Hideout boss or full layout during the opening encounter. After this quest, the den remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs.

Academy District: Dropout Takeover.name: Academy District: Dropout Takeover
Academy District: Dropout Takeover.questStatement: A powered dropout gang has occupied the abandoned academy training facility and turned its practice rooms into a dangerous proving ground. Kiyomi and Mika may be investigating at the entrance, but the player decides whether to enter alone or accept their help.
Academy District: Dropout Takeover.mainObjective: Investigate the powered dropout takeover at the abandoned training facility.

reach_facility.text: Approach the abandoned academy training facility and assess the dropout gang's takeover.

choose_approach.text: Choose whether to negotiate, sneak inside, accept assistance, or confront the dropouts.

enter_facility.text: Enter the facility and determine who controls the training wing.

completionCondition.query: The player has entered the abandoned academy training facility and established a clear approach to the powered dropout gang.

Academy District: Dropout Takeover.questDesignBrief: A one-time arrival and discovery quest for a level 1–20 replayable Hideout. The player encounters a powered dropout gang occupying a closed academy training facility. Kiyomi and Mika Tsukino may be present at the entrance and can offer optional assistance when their presence is plausible. The player may accept, decline, negotiate, sneak, investigate, or fight. Do not hard-gate the Hideout, reveal the entire layout, or force the player to recruit the two helpers. After the discovery quest, the facility remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs.

Central Tokyo: Parasite Lab Investigatio.name: Central Tokyo: Parasite Lab Investigation
Central Tokyo: Parasite Lab Investigatio.questStatement: A concealed underground laboratory beneath Central Tokyo has been breached, leaving behind quarantine failures, missing specimens, and evidence of a violent struggle. Elise Moreau is already there, investigating the parasite test subjects she calls "her people," and can offer optional assistance.
Central Tokyo: Parasite Lab Investigatio.mainObjective: Fight through the breached parasite laboratory and determine what escaped or remains contained.

reach_lab.text: Enter the concealed parasite laboratory while Elise investigates the breach.

assess_breach.text: Fight through the first containment failure and identify the most dangerous active threat.

choose_approach.text: Choose whether to secure the subjects, recover evidence, rescue survivors, or confront the infected threat.

completionCondition.query: The player has entered the parasite laboratory, fought through an initial threat, and established a clear approach to Elise's people and the containment breach.

Central Tokyo: Parasite Lab Investigatio.questDesignBrief: A one-time fast-paced arrival and discovery quest for a level 1–20 combat-focused Hideout. Elise Moreau is present at the entrance and may offer optional temporary assistance. The central conflict is Elise's guilt and protective attachment toward the parasite test subjects, whom she calls her people. The opening should move quickly into pressure or combat while allowing investigation, containment, rescue, negotiation, or direct confrontation. Keep Elise's hidden identities and personal quest separate from the lab's immediate conflict. Do not reveal the entire layout or boss during arrival. After discovery, the lab remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs.

Old Tokyo: Cursed Archive Breach.name: Old Tokyo: Cursed Archive Breach
Old Tokyo: Cursed Archive Breach.questStatement: A buried shrine archive beneath Old Tokyo has been breached, and relic thieves are using its curse as a weapon. Jeanne d'Arc is present at the entrance and can offer optional assistance.
Old Tokyo: Cursed Archive Breach.mainObjective: Enter the cursed archive and stop the relic thieves from worsening the curse.

reach_archive.text: Approach the breached shrine archive and survive the first curse hazard.

break_thief_line.text: Fight through the relic thieves and curse-afflicted defenders.

choose_response.text: Choose whether to cleanse, contain, recover, or exploit the cursed archive.

completionCondition.query: The player has entered the cursed archive, survived an initial curse encounter, and chosen how to respond to the inner curse.

Old Tokyo: Cursed Archive Breach.questDesignBrief: A one-time fast-paced arrival quest for a level 1–20 combat-focused Hideout. Jeanne d'Arc is present and offers optional assistance. The opening moves quickly into a curse hazard or fight while preserving choices to cleanse, contain, recover relics, negotiate with frightened thieves, or proceed alone. The archive remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs after discovery.

Tokyo Docks: Smuggler Yard Breach.name: Tokyo Docks: Smuggler Yard Breach
Tokyo Docks: Smuggler Yard Breach.questStatement: A smuggling operation is active across the Tokyo docks, using containers, warehouse routes, and powered criminals to move dangerous contraband. Luna and Tess are present at the entrance and can offer optional assistance.
Tokyo Docks: Smuggler Yard Breach.mainObjective: Break into the smuggler hideout, disrupt the operation, and decide how much cargo to recover or destroy.

reach_yard.text: Approach the dock hideout and survive the first smuggler response.

break_operation.text: Fight through the container yard and warehouse security.

choose_cargo_fate.text: Choose whether to recover, destroy, expose, or leave the contraband.

completionCondition.query: The player has entered the dock hideout, fought through an initial response, and chosen how to handle the smuggled cargo.

Tokyo Docks: Smuggler Yard Breach.questDesignBrief: A one-time fast-paced arrival quest for a level 1–20 combat-focused Hideout. Luna and Tess are present and offer optional assistance. The opening moves quickly into a container-yard fight, alarm, pursuit, or tactical route choice while preserving options to recover, destroy, expose, negotiate over, or abandon the cargo. The dock hideout remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs after discovery.

Central Tokyo: Blacksite Breach.name: Central Tokyo: Blacksite Breach
Central Tokyo: Blacksite Breach.questStatement: A covert corporate blacksite beneath Central Tokyo has activated its security teams and lockdown systems. Ichi Nawa is at the entrance and may offer technical assistance.
Central Tokyo: Blacksite Breach.mainObjective: Fight through the blacksite and reach its restricted vault.

breach_checkpoint.text: Break through the security checkpoint before the lockdown closes.

disable_defenses.text: Fight through the testing floor and disable or bypass the automated defenses.

reach_vault.text: Reach the restricted vault and decide what to do with the blacksite's prototypes and records.

completionCondition.query: The player has entered the corporate blacksite, fought through its active security response, and reached or secured a route toward the restricted vault.

Central Tokyo: Blacksite Breach.questDesignBrief: A one-time fast-paced arrival quest for a level 21–40 combat-focused Hideout. Ichi Nawa is present and offers optional assistance. Start with immediate security pressure, a lockdown, or an automated defense. Keep dialogue short and tactical. The blacksite remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs.

Shinjuku: Cursed Entertainment Takeover.name: Shinjuku: Cursed Entertainment Takeover
Shinjuku: Cursed Entertainment Takeover.questStatement: A Shinjuku entertainment complex has been overtaken by curse-users wielding corrupted relics. Lucien Han is at the entrance and may offer tactical assistance.
Shinjuku: Cursed Entertainment Takeover.mainObjective: Fight through the cursed entertainment district and disrupt the relic operation.

break_entrance.text: Survive the curse-user attack at the entertainment district entrance.

cross_venues.text: Fight through the concourse, backstage routes, and warped performance spaces.

disrupt_relic.text: Reach the ritual control room and decide whether to cleanse, destroy, or recover the corrupted relic.

completionCondition.query: The player has entered the cursed entertainment district, fought through its active defenses, and reached a route toward the relic operation.

Shinjuku: Cursed Entertainment Takeover.questDesignBrief: A one-time fast-paced arrival quest for a level 21–40 combat-focused Hideout. Lucien Han is present and offers optional assistance. Begin with immediate curse-user pressure or a warped venue hazard. Keep dialogue short and tactical. The Hideout remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs.

Kurokawa: Arms Exchange Breach.name: Kurokawa: Arms Exchange Breach
Kurokawa: Arms Exchange Breach.questStatement: A fortified Kurokawa arms exchange is preparing a major weapons transfer. Seo-jun Kang is at the entrance and may offer covert assistance.
Kurokawa: Arms Exchange Breach.mainObjective: Break through the arms exchange and disrupt or exploit the weapons transfer.

breach_exchange.text: Survive the armed response at the exchange entrance.

cross_defenses.text: Fight through the deal floor, armories, and defensive corridors.

reach_command.text: Reach the command suite and decide whether to seize, destroy, expose, or leave the weapons operation.

completionCondition.query: The player has entered the arms exchange, fought through its active defenses, and reached a route toward the command suite.

Kurokawa: Arms Exchange Breach.questDesignBrief: A one-time fast-paced arrival quest for a level 21–40 combat-focused Hideout. Seo-jun Kang is present and offers optional covert assistance. Keep Hush's identity and Elise's private knowledge separate and protected. Begin with immediate mercenary pressure or a weapons transfer going wrong. The Hideout remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs.

Tokyo Bay: Flooded Transit Breach.name: Tokyo Bay: Flooded Transit Breach
Tokyo Bay: Flooded Transit Breach.questStatement: A flooded transit hub beneath Tokyo Bay has been seized by powered raiders, with unstable electricity and stranded survivors inside. Minato is at the entrance and may offer combat and rescue assistance.
Tokyo Bay: Flooded Transit Breach.mainObjective: Fight through the flooded transit hub, manage its hazards, and stop the raider operation.

reach_concourse.text: Enter the flooded concourse and survive the first raider attack.

cross_flooded_lines.text: Fight across the platforms, tracks, and service tunnels while managing water and electricity.

secure_substation.text: Reach the power substation and decide whether to restore, shut down, or exploit the station systems.

completionCondition.query: The player has entered the flooded transit hub, fought through its active raider response, and reached a route toward the power substation.

Tokyo Bay: Flooded Transit Breach.questDesignBrief: A one-time fast-paced arrival quest for a level 21–40 combat-focused Hideout. Minato is present and offers optional assistance. Begin with immediate raider pressure, an electrical hazard, or a rescue problem. Keep dialogue short and tactical. The Hideout remains freely replayable for loot-seeking runs.

20-Hideout Hunter.name: 20-Hideout Hunter
20-Hideout Hunter.questStatement: Mel introduces the player to global LFG listings for Hideouts appropriate to their current level and asks them to begin hunting through the level 1–20 circuit.
20-Hideout Hunter.mainObjective: Use LFG to discover and clear the available level 1–20 Hideouts.

discover_lfg.text: Hear Mel's explanation of LFG and open the global Hideout listings.

clear_kurokawa.text: Clear Kurokawa Underground Den through its miniboss and boss.

clear_training_facility.text: Clear Academy District Abandoned Training Facility through its miniboss and boss.

clear_parasite_lab.text: Clear Central Tokyo Underground Parasite Lab through its miniboss and boss.

clear_shrine_archive.text: Clear Old Tokyo Cursed Shrine Archive through its miniboss and boss.

completionCondition.query: The player has used LFG to discover and cleared every available level 1–20 Hideout: Kurokawa Underground Den, Academy District Abandoned Training Facility, Central Tokyo Underground Parasite Lab, and Old Tokyo Cursed Shrine Archive.

20-Hideout Hunter.questDesignBrief: This is a story-start-only introductory quest for the 20-Hideout Hunter multiplayer start. Mel calls the player at Sakura Lane Sharehouse and explains that LFG can show Hideouts globally, filtered to listings whose authored level bands fit the player's level. Do not scale enemies to the player or reveal inaccessible higher-level Hideouts as suitable. Let the player choose party members, loot agreements, order, and whether to wait, recruit, hire, or enter solo. Each listed level 1–20 Hideout must still use its authored miniboss, boss, gacha loot, extraction, and persistent consequences. The quest should guide rather than force immediate travel; after completion, leave LFG available for future fitting Hideouts.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: Keep global LFG available as an optional organic channel. Mel recognizes the player's 20-Hideout Hunter progress without making future party membership mandatory.

Cleo: Bounty Call.name: Cleo: Bounty Call
Cleo: Bounty Call.questStatement: Cleo has called with a bounty-hunter contract and will provide a target, terms, proof requirements, payment, and complications if you accept.
Cleo: Bounty Call.mainObjective: Call Cleo and negotiate or accept a bounty-hunter job.

contact_cleo.text: Call Cleo and hear the available bounty contract.

choose_contract.text: Choose whether to accept, reject, or negotiate a bounty contract.

complete_bounty.text: Complete the accepted bounty according to Cleo's terms and return proof.

completionCondition.query: The player completes an accepted bounty contract and provides Cleo with the required proof.

Cleo: Bounty Call.questDesignBrief: A repeatable-feeling bounty contact quest with player choice, clear terms, nonlethal options, target-specific complications, and consequences for incomplete or harmful work.

Bad Night.name: Bad Night
Bad Night.questStatement: You woke up above Arbor Diner with dried blood on your clothes and no clear memory of the night before. Something was wrong with Camille. Someone else may know you were there. Figure out what happened before the truth finds you first.
Bad Night.mainObjective: Piece together what happened last night and decide how far to follow it.

question_olivia.text: Question Olivia about what she saw and how she found you.

talk_joe.text: Talk to Joe about Turned survival, Vermine, and the hunters.

inspect_injuries.text: Inspect your injuries and what they reveal about the attack.

search_apartment.text: Search the apartment above Arbor Diner for clues.

revisit_site.text: Return to the site of last night's attack.

check_phone.text: Check your phone for messages, calls, or clues.

investigate_hunters.text: Investigate whether your name appears on a hunter list.

ask_vermine.text: Ask about Vermine and who controls the Turned underground.

follow_camille.text: Follow rumors about Camille and why she was hunting.

completionCondition.query: The character pieces together a credible picture of what happened last night, identifies a suspect or deliberate target, and decides whether to keep digging or step away. This is complete when the player reaches a point of their own choosing: a lead resolved, a confrontation, a decision to stop, or a decision to follow the thread further.

Bad Night.questDesignBrief: An open-ended investigation quest that preserves player agency throughout. Present objectives as available leads, never as a forced checklist, and let the character pursue or ignore them in any order. Nothing is automatically accepted or discovered. Do not force the character into being Turned, joining Vermine, taking a Blacklisted contract, or confronting Camille. Keep Camille as a specific established NPC, not a random monster; she should be anchored to real history with Olivia and Joe and to the possibility that someone else was watching last night. Reveal answers only through the channels the character actually uses. On completion, grant exactly one Ability Point through the completion effect and present it as funding the character's first Starter Ability or first combat/survival specialization for powerless characters. Respect the Identity and Appearance Lock and the Knowledge Firewall at all times.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The player receives exactly one Ability Point, which may be used to create their first Starter Ability, or to unlock their first combat or survival specialization if the character is powerless. Present it without forcing the choice on whether or how to spend the point.

Before the Hunt.name: Before the Hunt
Before the Hunt.questStatement: Florence wants proof that you can investigate a Turned case instead of blindly following a bounty. Your first contract begins with a spar, a briefing, and a target whose story may not match the paperwork.
Before the Hunt.mainObjective: Complete your first Turned investigation with Florence and decide how the target should be handled.

spar_florence.text: Spar with Florence and show her how you move under pressure.

review_contract.text: Review the contract for the reported hostile Turned.

inspect_location.text: Inspect the target's last known location.

question_witnesses.text: Question witnesses and compare their accounts.

search_evidence.text: Search for biological or environmental evidence.

identify_target.text: Identify the Turned connected to the incident.

assess_hostility.text: Determine whether the target is actually hostile.

choose_outcome.text: Choose whether to capture, eliminate, rescue, observe, or let the target escape.

debrief_florence.text: Return to Florence and debrief her on what happened.

completionCondition.query: The character completes a first Turned investigation with Florence, reaches the target or resolves the case, chooses an outcome or allows the target to escape, and debriefs Florence or otherwise establishes the result.

Before the Hunt.questDesignBrief: Begin at Ultra Force Headquarters, where Florence is waiting on the training deck and demands a spar before briefing the player. Preserve every response option: accept, refuse, joke, question the job, size her up, use powers, or fight without powers. The spar evaluates movement, panic, improvisation, and knowing when to stop; it does not require victory. Then present a contract: a Turned was reportedly feeding near a residential district, two people are missing, blood was found, witness accounts conflict, and the order says capture or elimination authorized. Investigation is mandatory to the job's structure, but the moral answer is never predetermined. Support bounty, tracking, capture, investigation, disappearance, cleanup, rescue, Vermine, and rogue-hunter outcomes. Clients, witnesses, targets, and hunters may lie. Do not force the player to inherit Florence's beliefs, kill a target, join a faction, or accept a contract beyond this story start. On completion grant exactly one Ability Point and unlock Turned Hunter Contracts through story, without forcing how the point is spent.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: The player receives exactly one Ability Point and unlocks Turned Hunter Contracts, allowing specialized Turned-hunting jobs to become available throughout Tokyo. Do not force the player to spend the Ability Point or accept a contract.

The Incident Nobody Owns.name: The Incident Nobody Owns
The Incident Nobody Owns.questStatement: A powered incident has thrown Academy Gate Station into chaos while mercenaries search the crowd for Nami “Fourfold” Sato, a witness Crown Meridian wants recovered.
The Incident Nobody Owns.mainObjective: Survive the station crisis, protect Nami if possible, and determine why the official explanation does not match the evidence.

secure_evidence.text: Inspect damaged equipment, emergency records, mercenary behavior, or another credible lead.

escort_to_cover.text: Get Nami out of the open before the mercenary team seals the exits.

stop_coverup.text: Prevent the advance team from erasing the evidence in the damaged equipment.

completionCondition.query: The station crisis reaches a meaningful outcome: Nami is protected, captured, escapes, is handed to another authority, or the player deliberately leaves after learning mercenaries were searching for her.

The Incident Nobody Owns.questDesignBrief:
No prerequisites. Minato is helping injured commuters, Isabelle is treating a victim, and Crown Meridian mercenaries search for Nami. Nami is a witness and participant, not a passive package. Offer rescue, investigation, hiding, negotiation, evacuation, confrontation, or departure. Do not assume player knowledge or decisions. If the player leaves, preserve an altered continuation with weaker evidence.

Action design: Open with a chase-pressure set-piece: armor-clad mercenaries sweeping the platforms while a panicked crowd floods the concourse. As the player responds, a two-man advance team locks down the damaged research equipment and starts wiping logs. Give the player a genuine tactical choice: fight the mercenaries (combat with mooks using utility and grenade-type equipment), slip Nami through service corridors (stealth/evasion checks against patrol timing), or negotiate a temporary stand-down (persuasion/deception versus a skeptical mercenary lead). Add a containment timer: each failed escape attempt raises crowd casualties and lets the advance team erase one evidence source, visibly weakening the next chapter. Include a skill check gate: reconnaissance or tech skill spots the false 'inspector' whose badge predates the incident.

The Witness with Three Names.name: The Witness with Three Names
The Witness with Three Names.questSource: Nami “Fourfold” Sato and surviving station evidence
The Witness with Three Names.questStatement: Nami’s records contain three identities: her true name, a Crown Meridian designation, and a false civilian identity.
The Witness with Three Names.mainObjective: Keep Nami alive and free long enough to establish what she personally witnessed and who created the conflicting identities.

secure_survival.text: Establish a safe, voluntary place or route for Nami.

compare_identities.text: Compare Nami’s three identities through records, witnesses, or communication.

lose_pursuers.text: Lose the pursuing mercenary detail through stealth, misdirection, or traffic.

guard_hideout.text: Defend Nami when a backup team raids the chosen shelter.

completionCondition.query: Nami has a meaningful safety arrangement or escape outcome, and the player establishes one reliable fact about her identities or pursuers.

The Witness with Three Names.questDesignBrief:
Nami may be sheltered through Isabelle, Maya, Ken, Minato, official care, or another plausible route, but nobody forces her into a party. Her active personas may remember different fragments; this is not proof of deception. Include pursuit pressure and allow hiding, legal protection, negotiation, or escape. The first concrete clue points toward an altered pre-incident report.

Action design: Make the exit live with a running chase: escorted routes trigger quick-time evasion and concealment rolls as the mercenary detail reactivates. Crossing the District Hub presses crowd-wading, rooftop, and station shortcuts against patrol timers. If the player shelters Nami, run a raid set-piece where a backup team forces the door — combat or a deliberate stand-down that orients the next chapter. Layer one identity-reveal check, probably investigation or empathy conversation, that exposes a 'trusted' escort as a Crown Meridian contractor, forcing the player to re-route with reduced time.

A Report That Arrived Early.name: A Report That Arrived Early
A Report That Arrived Early.questStatement: The official station report was timestamped before the disaster occurred, suggesting that someone anticipated or engineered the incident.
A Report That Arrived Early.mainObjective: Verify the impossible timestamp and trace who had access to the report before the crisis.

verify_timestamp.text: Obtain and verify the original station or emergency timestamp.

compare_accounts.text: Compare station, civilian, medical, and security accounts.

purge_in_network.text: A network erasure agent is deleting the source records in real time.

intercept_wiper.text: Intercept or outrun the erasure agent before the archived logs are gone.

completionCondition.query: The player verifies or reconstructs that the report predates the incident and chooses a credible custodian or use for the evidence.

A Report That Arrived Early.questDesignBrief:
Interweave Isabelle’s medical observation with Ken’s legal and records expertise. Minato can help locate a frightened employee but does not automatically understand the conspiracy. Nami’s testimony remains limited to what the relevant identity could remember. Public exposure, quiet preservation, legal action, factional leverage, secrecy, and other credible approaches are valid.

Action design: Turn record-verification into an active purge race. Attach an erasure timer: a Crown Meridian agent is deleting source logs and jamming remote access, so the player must physically reach physical tape vaults or chase the agent. Use cryptography or tech checks to beat the wipe window, a pursuit to corner the agent, and negotiation or combat to recover the untouched master. If the fight succeeds badly, records surface partially, bleeding into the next chapter. A secondary stealth objective lets the player slip into the server room, copy the report, and place a decoy the agent wipes instead — cleaner evidence, higher risk of alarm.

The Wrong Emergency Contact.name: The Wrong Emergency Contact
The Wrong Emergency Contact.questStatement: A wounded station victim was routed through an emergency contact chain leading to a Crown Meridian contractor rather than the hospital or listed family contact.
The Wrong Emergency Contact.mainObjective: Follow the medical discrepancy and determine whether the injured people were treated, monitored, or used as research data.

trace_transfer.text: Trace the victim’s emergency transfer or referral record.

safe_patient_move.text: Move the patient before contractor med-staff arrive to sweep the ward.

hold_the_ward.text: Turn back or distract the medical extraction team if they force entry.

expose_false_clinic.text: Expose the contractor-run false clinic that 'received' the referral.

completionCondition.query: The player traces the medical discrepancy, establishes a patient-safety outcome, and learns that Crown Meridian sought biological, power, or recovery data.

The Wrong Emergency Contact.questDesignBrief:
Isabelle and Sofia are not interchangeable healers. Isabelle offers risky leverage-based underground care; Sofia offers cooperative mutual aid while keeping her identity private. Allow hospital care, underground care, legal protection, evidence exchange, or another credible route. Do not reveal Sofia’s Turned identity automatically.

Action design: Stage a tense protected-medical set-piece in the ward. Contractor extraction staff move methodically from room to room with name-tagged stretchers; the player chooses direct confrontation, disguise-and-swap rooms, fast evacuation (mobility checks under a doors-begin-locking timer), or leaning on Isabelle to stall clinically. Raid the false clinic behind it: force your way past guards or slip a technician team in to recover the monitoring hardware before it ships. Include one medicine or first-aid check to keep a patient stable through the chaos; failure raises the cost of the safe route.

onCompleteEffects.value: The Student Who Saw the Equipment

The Student Who Saw the Equipment.name: The Student Who Saw the Equipment
The Student Who Saw the Equipment.questSource: Minato and Chikara Academy student witnesses
The Student Who Saw the Equipment.questStatement: A student saw experimental equipment near the station before the incident, but school rumors, corporate attention, and fear are pressuring the witness into silence.
The Student Who Saw the Equipment.mainObjective: Protect the student witness and determine what the equipment was measuring.

find_witness.text: Locate the student witness through a plausible school, transit, or social lead.

identify_equipment.text: Determine whether the equipment measured powers, memories, biology, or something else.

steal_memory_card.text: Recover the photo or memory card the student kept before the corporation seizes it.

outrun_intercept.text: Outrun or evade a corporate intercept team during campus transfer.

completionCondition.query: The student witness has a safety outcome and the player establishes a credible connection between the station equipment and experimental power-response research.

The Student Who Saw the Equipment.questDesignBrief:
Minato can be a social bridge without becoming the automatic leader. The student may be found through academy routines, the student quarter, station contacts, or another plausible route. Nami only knows her own fragments; the student only knows what they observed. Reveal a Crown Meridian symbol or phrase and a lead toward restricted operational records.

Action design: Run a chase across the campus: the student is being pulled toward a corporate recruiting van under pressuring 'guidance.' The player must reach the transfer point before the doors shut — dash through the student quarter crowd, or cut across courtyards. If the student already handed off a photo, mount a stealth and pursuit to recover the memory card from the recruiter’s briefcase. A rooftop or maintenance-chase breaks patrol pressure; catching a school-adjacent corporate 'counselor' and pressing them gives a persuasion/deception showdown that secures the student and reveals the Crown Meridian symbol.

A Favor from the Blacklisted.name: A Favor from the Blacklisted
A Favor from the Blacklisted.questSource: Ichi Nawa, Florence, and Blacklisted operational records
A Favor from the Blacklisted.questStatement: The station equipment appears in a redacted Blacklisted operation, but Ichi, Florence, and Ren disagree about what the mission was meant to accomplish.
A Favor from the Blacklisted.mainObjective: Obtain and interpret the restricted operation record without treating the Blacklisted as one unified voice.

request_access.text: Find a plausible route to a Blacklisted record or witness.

win_the_drill.text: Earn access by passing the training-workout the program requires of the player.

retrieve_record.text: Recover the redacted record from a locked operations vault.

defend_during_raid.text: Survive a raid by Crown Meridian contractors hunting the recovered record.

completionCondition.query: The player obtains or reconstructs a restricted record linking the station equipment to a Crown Meridian contractor while the Blacklisted perspectives remain distinct.

A Favor from the Blacklisted.questDesignBrief:
Ichi offers supervised reform expertise, Florence offers hostile target classification, and Ren contributes incomplete memory. None speaks for the whole Blacklisted program. Access may require a favor, protection, evidence exchange, or refusal of a harmful request. The record reveals a Crown Meridian charity demonstration and a planned second disaster test.

Action design: Make access concrete instead of conversational: the program gatekeeper routes the player through a short training-workout (athletics/fitness checks) as a show of reliability before handing over the vault key — a small, guided combat-and-discipline set-piece. The vault is lockpicking or tech-failure sensitive and tripping alarms triggers a breakout. Cap it with a raid: Crown Meridian contractors breach the facility for the recovered archive; the player and the Blacklisted element hold a choke point (combat or coordinated evacuation). This makes the 'favor' tangible and sets up hard civilian consequences if the defense fails.

The Charity Demonstration.name: The Charity Demonstration
The Charity Demonstration.questStatement: Crown Meridian hosts a polished charity demonstration of power-safety technology while hiding the research network implicated in the station disaster.
The Charity Demonstration.mainObjective: Investigate the demonstration, protect civilians and witnesses, and learn what Crown Meridian is testing beneath its public image.

enter_event.text: Attend, infiltrate, observe, or investigate the demonstration through a plausible route.

manage_unlikely_allies.text: Coordinate or negotiate with an unlikely established ally.

intercept_demo_unit.text: Seize or redirect a staged demonstration unit before it detonates as a controlled hazard.

disable_monitoring.text: Disable the hidden monitoring rig that tags every powered person in the crowd.

completionCondition.query: The player investigates or disrupts the demonstration, protects or knowingly abandons a meaningful civilian interest, and obtains evidence about the network’s broader objective.

The Charity Demonstration.questDesignBrief:
This is the first deliberate unlikely-group crossover. Minato may access the social event, Isabelle may investigate medical technology, Krell may identify nonhuman design elements, and a supernatural contact may recognize a curse-like component. Do not require every ally. Allow attendance, infiltration, exposure, theft, sabotage, or departure. Reveal that the next test will create a larger powered disaster.

Action design: Build a public-event set-piece with two simultaneous pressures. One: a discreet infiltration objective to reach and disable a hidden monitoring rig before the demonstration broadcast starts — stealth and technology checks against a moving crowd and timed security rounds. Two: a staged demonstration unit begins to overload as a controlled hazard; the player must intercept and either disarm it (tech/skill), contain the blast, or smuggle it offstage, while keeping panicking civilians moving. Mine the crossover for mechanical interplay: Minato opens social doors, Krell traces the 'signal,' and a supernatural contact absorbs or redirects a curse-like residue. A high-fail outcome lets one unit detonate, giving real casualties and a weaker next lead.

The Second Disaster Test.name: The Second Disaster Test
The Second Disaster Test.questStatement: A second powered disaster is being staged to test the Crown Meridian system under public pressure, forcing incompatible groups to choose whether to cooperate.
The Second Disaster Test.mainObjective: Prevent, contain, expose, or survive the second disaster test while preserving as many lives and choices as possible.

find_test_site.text: Identify the location or conditions of the second engineered test.

evacuate_ground_zero.text: Keep civilians moving ahead of the escalating effect at ground zero.

hold_the_breach.text: Hold the breach point against staged hostiles while teams work the cause.

cut_the_trigger.text: Cut the external trigger unit before the engineered peak hits.

completionCondition.query: The second disaster test is prevented, contained, exposed, redirected, or allowed to cause consequences, and the player has a clear lead to the Crown Meridian archive.

The Second Disaster Test.questDesignBrief:
Use prior relationships and choices to shape the response team. Possible participants include Minato, Isabelle, Nami, Maya, Ken, Krell, Ichi, Florence, or Sofia, but never force everyone into one team. Include disagreement about rescue, evidence, disclosure, and faction risk. A failed or partial response alters the next quest rather than deleting the arc.

Action design: Run the arc’s biggest action set-piece: a cascading disaster with a hard countdown. First locate the trigger electronics while the effect escalates — tech and reconnaissance under a pressure timer. Then split active play between evacuating ground-zero civilians (mobility, crowd-handling, rescue under falling debris and growing static) and holding a breach where staged hostiles cut off the containment team. The climax is cutting the external trigger unit: reach it, disarm it, or detonate it early as a gamble. Failure escalates one hazard tier and adds casualties; partial success stalls the disaster and redirects blame onto a decoy faction, feeding the next chapter’s evidence angle. Firefighting, medicine, and rescue skills shine here as meaningful expedition resources.

The Crown Meridian Archive.name: The Crown Meridian Archive
The Crown Meridian Archive.questStatement: A restricted archive contains records connecting Crown Meridian’s experiments, engineered disasters, and faction manipulation across Tokyo.
The Crown Meridian Archive.mainObjective: Reach the archive, decide who should see the evidence, and determine whether exposing it will protect or endanger the people named in it.

secure_records.text: Copy or protect the records before the backup scrub runs.

locate_route.text: Locate a viable route to the Crown Meridian archive.

infiltrate_level.text: Break into and move unseen through the restricted archive level.

escape_floor.text: Escape or fight clear of the floor once the breach is detected.

completionCondition.query: The player reaches or meaningfully accesses the archive and chooses a course for its records, with the major cross-arc connections established through evidence.

The Crown Meridian Archive.questDesignBrief:
This investigation may become stealth, negotiation, rescue, or combat. Do not force a party composition. Ken handles legal evidence, Maya safe routes, Ichi supervised hero support, Isabelle medical evidence, Krell unusual technology, and Nami only personal or persona-specific fragments. Reveal that the network is built from several projects; leave the final decision for the next quest.

Action design: Design a full three-beat infiltration. Beat one: reach the archive realm through vents, elevator-shaft descents, or a breached service corridor, using tech, stealth, and lockpicking against patrol schedules and live floor scans. Beat two: inside the vault, pressure mounts as a backup scrub runs on a visible timer; the player must reach the master server, defeat its security manifold (tech or combat versus a defensive 'shikigami-like' AI unit), and copy or protect the records. Beat three: the breach is detected, so flee the floor — a fire-chase through collapsing server rooms, duel at the exits, or a helper's coordinate-guided sprint — or stand and clear the floor outright. Failure on any beat strands partial evidence and forces a riskier follow-up.

The Machine Beneath the Brand.name: The Machine Beneath the Brand
The Machine Beneath the Brand.questSource: The Crown Meridian archive and affected witnesses
The Machine Beneath the Brand.questStatement: The archive reveals a system designed to make Tokyo’s incompatible power phenomena measurable, controllable, and weaponizable.
The Machine Beneath the Brand.mainObjective: Confront the Crown Meridian network and choose the future of its research, evidence, victims, and public truth.

interpret_machine.text: Understand what the system was built to measure and control.

choose_future.text: Choose whether to destroy, expose, seize, distribute, conceal, or otherwise resolve the research and evidence.

cut_control_node.text: Disable or seize the control node that lets the network quarantine experiments.

secure_victims.text: Extract affected survivors, including Nami, from the locked floors.

completionCondition.query: The player confronts the Crown Meridian network and makes a consequential choice about its research, evidence, affected people, and public truth.

The Machine Beneath the Brand.questDesignBrief:
This is the Broken Crown finale, not a single mandatory boss fight. Assemble Minato, Isabelle, Nami, Ken, Maya, Krell, Ichi, Florence, Sofia, Ren, Elise, Oblivion, Ryota, or others only when plausibly connected by prior choices. Nami retains agency. Possible outcomes include exposure, destruction, seizure, distributed evidence, coalition control, protective secrecy, or another credible solution. Resolve consequences in later arcs; do not force the player’s dialogue, thoughts, feelings, consent, romance, or final decision.

Action design: Make the finale a multi-front climactic sequence rather than one boss. Front one: cut the control node that quarantines the experiments — a guarded server core that may be stormed, ghosted, or socially bypassed. Front two: as the lockdown starts, extract affected survivors from the locked floors with a running rescue set-piece, each victim demanding a defensive or medical choice. Front three: the network unleashes a final engineered surge, so the player must contain, redirect, expose, or fully destroy it — a defensive hold, a sabotage window, or a broadcast decision. Interleave these with a predetermined confrontation dialogue that lets the player choose the ending lever (public exposure, negotiated truce, protective secrecy, or total destruction). Each failed front tilts consequences for later arcs, but no single failure deletes the truth.

Power Circuit Registration.name: Power Circuit Registration
Power Circuit Registration.questStatement: At the Central Battle Coliseum registration desk, Mel asks how many fighters are entering and who intends to compete.
Power Circuit Registration.mainObjective: Register a Circuit roster of up to eight competitors from players and eligible NPCs, with human players always prioritized.

choose_entry_mode.text: Register solo, with current party members, or with recruited NPC partners at the Power Circuit desk.

select_competitors.text: Choose the competitors for the Circuit roster, up to eight, favoring human players over NPCs.

confirm_roster.text: Confirm the roster with Mel and accept her training or safety terms.

leave_format_open.text: Leave tournament format selection (1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, or a special event) until a specific Circuit event begins.

completionCondition.query: The player has registered a Power Circuit roster of up to eight competitors from players and eligible NPCs, with human players prioritized, and chosen to leave the tournament format open until an event begins.

Power Circuit Registration.questSource: Power Circuit registration desk at the Central Battle Coliseum registration-desk area
Power Circuit Registration.questDesignBrief: Allows solo, party, and NPC registration with human players always prioritized. Mel is the primary trainer and registration contact and reacts to party size, especially an eight-person roster. Roster selection is optional and deferred; unused competitors may spectate, train, socialize, or enter side events. NPC partners may accept, refuse, have personal reasons, or withdraw. Do not force registration, universal fights, romance, prizes, fame, victory, or tournament entry. Format selection is left to the later Circuit event quest rather than this registration.

onCompleteEffects.instruction: Mel files the roster and points the newly registered fighters at the Open Qualifier: every new fighter must finish it before any other Circuit event.

Power Circuit Event.name: Power Circuit Event
Power Circuit Event.questStatement: The Power Circuit has opened a combat tournament at Central Battle Coliseum. Choose the bracket, field willing fighters, and survive the matches under declared arena rules.
Power Circuit Event.mainObjective: Resolve a combat-focused Power Circuit tournament through brackets, team fights, knockouts, ring-outs, surrender, or official stoppage.

choose_format.text: Choose the combat format: 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, or a larger special combat event.

address_outcome.text: Address the tournament's immediate combat consequences, including recovery, fatigue, injuries, reputation, relationships, official records, invitations, and scheduling.

seed_bracket.text: Seed the bracket or assign combat teams from willing registered competitors, keeping human players prioritized and leaving others free to spectate or join side events.

confirm_rules.text: Confirm combat rules, legal powers and equipment, arena boundaries, surrender, ring-out, time limits, medical oversight, and referee intervention.

fight_rounds.text: Fight the scheduled combat rounds, tracking targets, positioning, party actions, injuries, power strain, equipment, knockouts, ring-outs, surrender, and retreat.

resolve_bracket.text: Determine advancement or elimination through the declared combat result: knockout, incapacitation, ring-out, surrender, time decision, or referee stoppage.

completionCondition.query: The player has chosen a combat format, assigned willing competitors, confirmed combat rules and stakes, resolved the scheduled tournament fights through declared combat outcomes, and addressed the immediate aftermath.

Power Circuit Event.questSource: Power Circuit combat tournament board and officials at Central Battle Coliseum
Power Circuit Event.questDesignBrief: This is a combat-focused tournament, not a general team activity. Default formats are 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4; special events use a clearly stated combat variation. Build a bracket or match schedule from the registered roster, prioritizing human players and never forcing NPCs to fight. Before a match, disclose legal powers, equipment, arena boundaries, round or time limits, surrender, ring-out, medical oversight, referee intervention, and agreed stakes. A match normally ends when a fighter is knocked out, medically unable to continue, incapacitated under the declared rules, forced out of bounds, surrenders, loses on a time decision, or officials stop it for safety. Track each combatant's location, visibility, target, injuries, defenses, resources, power strain, tactics, and available support. Present party members and willing teammates as active combatants according to their abilities and independent judgment; do not make them idle or perfect puppets. Noncombat actions such as rescue, negotiation, or objective play may appear only as authored special-event rules, not as the default victory condition. Player-versus-player combat requires explicit mutual consent and agreed stakes. Do not guarantee victory, fame, money, powers, romance, permanent injury, or death.

Call Mel: Combat Finder.name: Call Mel: Combat Finder
Call Mel: Combat Finder.questStatement: After registering for the Power Circuit, call Mel from your phone to find an active fight, tournament, exhibition, or combat event.
Call Mel: Combat Finder.mainObjective: Use Mel's combat-finder service to select an available fight that fits the player's preferences, party, and current Circuit access.

open_menu.text: Call Mel and open the combat-finder menu.

choose_request.text: Choose a request such as any fights, a solo fight, a team fight, training, rivals, underground events, monster fights, special rules, or major tournaments.

review_options.text: Review available events, entry requirements, location, start time, format, difficulty, opponents if known, rules, and rewards.

select_event.text: Select an event, ask Mel to find anything suitable, or decline and keep searching later.

begin_combat_activity.text: Travel to the selected event and begin its authored or procedural combat quest.

completionCondition.query: The player has called Mel, reviewed combat-event options, and selected an event or deliberately declined after receiving useful recommendations.

Call Mel: Combat Finder.questSource: Mel's unlocked phone contact after Power Circuit registration
Call Mel: Combat Finder.questDesignBrief: This is a repeatable combat-content finder, not a replacement for Mel's NPC character. Do not edit Mel's NPC file, character details, abilities, personality, location, or story relationships. Mel remains an independent character with her established demonic contract, history, boundaries, and agency. Calling Mel opens a phone menu with: Any fights going on?, Find me a fight, Team fights, Tournament schedule, Check my ranking, Ask about opponent, Training, Rivals, Circuit news, and Never mind. Mel searches authored and procedural combat events using Circuit Rank, current location, time of day, story progress, faction reputation, active rivals, party size, current season, recent fights, player level, and abilities. Prioritize authored events and avoid repeatedly offering the exact same event; if no suitable authored event is available, offer a procedural Circuit match. Results should include event name, opponent or opponent profile if known, power or rank, format, arena, difficulty, entry fee if any, prize, special rules, optional story hook, start time, and requirements. Team requests must account for current party size and allow entering together or browsing individual matches. Generated opponents can become persistent rivals only after an interesting authored outcome; preserve their prior result, techniques, equipment, rank, and recognition. Mel should have opinions and use her established voice without becoming a sterile interface. Do not guarantee availability, victory, money, fame, romance, or safe outcomes. Selecting an event should surface or create the appropriate repeatable combat quest and give the player its location and start conditions.

Power Circuit: Open Qualifier.name: Power Circuit: Open Qualifier
Power Circuit: Open Qualifier.questStatement: Every newly registered fighter must complete the Open Qualifier at the Coliseum. Your first match and initial Circuit standing are on the line.
Power Circuit: Open Qualifier.mainObjective: Complete the Open Qualifier and establish your initial Circuit standing with Mel as your assigned trainer.

report_to_arena.text: Follow the announcer's call and report to Arena Three for the Open Qualifier.

register_profile.text: Complete your Circuit Profile with Mel, including fighter name, power style, fighting specialty, and any team name.

review_bracket.text: Review the Open Qualifier bracket, your competitors, and the rules before your match.

prepare.text: Prepare for your qualifying match: warm up, review your abilities, or coordinate with the group in the Coliseum between rounds.

fight_qualifier.text: Fight your Open Qualifier match, or decline if you decide not to proceed; resolve the result under the declared arena rules.

establish_standing.text: Establish your initial Circuit standing based on the qualifier result, and receive your first ranking and Call Mel unlock.

learn_next.text: Learn your next options from Mel: open tournaments, ranked matches, training, or continuing in the Circuit.

completionCondition.query: The player has completed the Open Qualifier, established an initial Circuit standing and profile, and learned their next options from Mel without receiving automatic fame, money, powers, or a guaranteed tournament win.

Power Circuit: Open Qualifier.questSource: Power Circuit registration and the Coliseum Open Qualifier
Power Circuit: Open Qualifier.questDesignBrief: This is the first player-facing quest of the Power Circuit storyline. Keep it a genuine gate: every newly registered fighter must complete the Open Qualifier to establish initial standing. Depending on the number of players, everyone may be placed in the same tournament bracket, and players may fight NPCs, watch other player matches, prepare together, explore between rounds, or potentially face one another. Mel is the group's assigned trainer for the Power Circuit. She is a full independent character and must not be reduced to a menu or a combat tutorial bot; do not edit or rewrite her hidden details, abilities, personality, history, or any established relationships in this work. The qualifier resolves under combat-focused arena rules (knockout, ring-out, surrender, time decision, or referee stoppage) consistent with the Power Circuit combat tournament. Do not guarantee the player's victory, a high initial rank, fame, money, or heroic legitimacy. Player-versus-player matches require explicit mutual consent and agreed stakes. Establishing standing should unlock Call Mel so the player can use combat-finder content afterward. Keep the outcome meaningful but leave the player's competitive future open to player choice.

Invoker: First Invocation.name: Invoker: First Invocation
Invoker: First Invocation.questStatement: Choose an Invocation class, perform the ritual, and meet the independent legend that answers your call.
Invoker: First Invocation.mainObjective: Establish a Pact with an Invocation after choosing its combat class and discovering who or what answered.

choose_class.text: Choose the Invocation class before the ritual: Blade, Lancer, Marksman, Rider, Caster, Stalker, or Berserker.

prepare_ritual.text: Choose the ritual's location, intention, circumstances, safety boundaries, and any objects or catalysts without assuming the result.

perform_ritual.text: Perform the Invocation Ritual and allow class, personality, attributes, circumstances, catalysts, location, compatibility, and chance to influence the answer.

meet_invocation.text: Meet the Invocation as an independent persistent NPC and establish its True Name, alias if needed, appearance, origin, personality, legend, abilities, strengths, weaknesses, Legendary Release, goals, secrets, modern-world opinions, and initial opinion of the Invoker.

negotiate_pact.text: Discuss Pact terms, autonomy, energy needs, Command Seals, risks, boundaries, and whether both sides agree to continue.

establish_bond.text: Experience an initial meaningful interaction that establishes the relationship's starting direction without forcing trust, friendship, romance, obedience, or heroism.

completionCondition.query: The player has chosen an Invocation class, performed the ritual, met the independent Invocation, and established or deliberately declined a Pact after discussing terms and experiencing an initial meaningful interaction.

Invoker: First Invocation.questSource: Invoker power-style selection and the first Invocation Ritual
Invoker: First Invocation.questDesignBrief: The player must choose the Invocation class before generation. Do not choose the class or legendary figure for them. After class selection, generate an appropriate Invocation influenced by class, player personality and attributes, ritual circumstances, catalysts, location, compatibility, and chance. Create the Invocation as a persistent major NPC identity for the playthrough, not as a Spirit Manifestation, equipment item, pet, generic summon, or fragment of the player's soul. Give the Invocation a True Name, alias when appropriate, appearance, personality, origin, interpretation of its legend, combat style, unique abilities, strengths, weaknesses, Legendary Release, goals, secrets, modern-world opinions, and initial opinion of the Invoker. Establish three Command Seals, hidden Bond, independent behavior, Resonance Attack potential, and dematerialization rules through play. The Invocation can speak, fight, socialize, argue, refuse, hide information, pursue goals, form relationships, and remember treatment. Do not force heroism, obedience, romance, trust, or permanent loss.

Storm Over the Breakwater.name: Storm Over the Breakwater
Storm Over the Breakwater.questStatement: A storm is sitting over Harborlight's breakwater and nowhere else. Lifeguards are clearing the beach, the resort is shuttering its windows, and someone has taken the tide-control station on the sea wall; the floodgates are groaning open a little at a time.
Storm Over the Breakwater.mainObjective: Investigate the storm on the Harborlight breakwater and stop whoever holds the tide-control station from flooding the shore.

reach_shoreline.text: Reach the storm-lashed shoreline and assess the danger.
